We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.

tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie

DePuy Synthes is establishing a standalone Orthopaedics company. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months of the original announcement date of October 2025, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.
Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes, and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.
DePuy Synthes, a ~$9 billion business, has an outstanding opportunity for a Senior Finance Manager operating within Supply Chain Finance to gain extensive exposure across DePuy Synthes Principal Operations while leading the Currency Management team.
Role Overview
In this role, you will provide financial leadership to the Currency Management team, leading the identification and management of foreign currency exposures, centralized hedging, hedge and inventory accounting, forecasting, analytics and reporting across DePuy Synthes.
You will play a critical role in standing up the group to operate as a standalone DePuy Synthes Principal Operations team, ensuring that essential currency management activities continue to be performed to the highest standards of compliance, accuracy and insight before, during and after separation.
The immediate focus of the role will be to stand up the Currency Management team and its operating model; establish the end-to-end exposure identification, hedge submission, accounting and control processes required to support placement of hedges through a third-party provider; and lead the development and ongoing maintenance of replacement calculation and analytics capabilities as existing systems will not be available to DePuy Synthes following separation.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, coach and develop a global team of three finance professionals.
Serve as the first point of contact for currency-related topics and questions across DePuy Synthes.
Lead the identification and management of foreign currency exposures, including centralized forecasting and balance sheet hedging, and establish the process required to place hedges with a third-party provider.
Ensure accurate and compliant hedge and inventory accounting in line with US GAAP and relevant accounting procedures.
Lead the calculation, analysis, reporting and communication of actual and forecast transactional currency impacts across DePuy Synthes P&L lines, including driver-based variance analysis, trends, risks and opportunities.
Provide currency analytics, insights and recommendations to DSPO, FP&A, Treasury and senior management.
Lead regular currency and hedge-result reviews with business partners and senior leadership and provide training and educational materials to strengthen understanding of currency and hedging principles across DePuy Synthes.
Lead the design, build, testing and deployment of a replacement tool to support currency calculations, hedging, analytics and reporting, and oversee its ongoing maintenance and enhancement.
Drive standardized and efficient processes through automation and analytics tools, including Power BI and Alteryx.
Partner across DSPO, Treasury, Tax, FP&A, Technology and Project Osprey teams to stand up the Currency Management team and ensure continuity of critical activities through separation.
Qualifications And Experience
Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably with a major in Accounting, Economics or Finance; a Master’s degree, MBA or recognized financial qualification such as ACA, ACCA or CIMA is preferred.
Minimum of 7 years of finance, accounting or related business experience.
Demonstrated leadership capability, with the ability to develop others, support organizational health and remove barriers to success.
Strong analytical skills and proven ability to bring clarity to complex business issues, manage complex projects and processes, and translate complexity into practical solutions.
Excellent communication and business partnering skills, including the ability to frame complex data, simplify written communications, influence internal customers and work effectively with all management levels.
Confident presenting to senior management, facilitating discussion and providing clear recommendations and solutions.
Ability to operate independently in a dynamic, high-visibility global environment, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across a virtual matrix organization.
Strong continuous improvement mindset; Supply Chain experience and proficiency with TMI, Alteryx or Power BI are preferred.
Demonstrated understanding of AI concepts and frameworks, including awareness of responsible and ethical AI practices, and has experience generating effective prompts to boost efficiency and productivity.
Leadership Capabilities
Leads and develops talent through coaching, delegation and clear accountability.
Builds trusted relationships and influences effectively across a global organization.
Combines strategic thinking with strong execution, prioritization and attention to detail.
Demonstrates integrity, resilience and a strong continuous improvement mindset.
Our Culture of Inclusion
Our Credo guides our commitment to an inclusive work environment where every person is respected as an individual. We value different abilities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and we want every colleague to belong, thrive and reach their potential.

The IT/OT Support Engineer is responsible for maintaining and managing operational technology (OT) systems, supporting virtual machine infrastructure, and managing user access while ensuring the security and integrity of critical OT environments. As part of the role, work will include high risk remediation planning and execution, secure segmentation, support for firewall lockdown rules, development of low-level designs and threat monitoring, review and development of BCP plans for OT systems, and support for a culture of training and awareness in OTCS.

Submit IT service requests related to network, server, and firewall infrastructure.

Implement secure segmentation across OT networks to minimize lateral movement and enhance containment.
Support the development and enforcement of firewall lockdown rules to protect OT assets.
Contribute to the development of low-level designs (LLD) for OT systems and establish ongoing threat monitoring capabilities.
Review and develop Business Continuity Plans (BCP) for OT systems to ensure rapid recovery and continuity of operations.
Promote and support a culture of training and awareness within OTCS, including regular training programs and security awareness initiatives.

CCNA certification

Understanding of Switch Network Solutions.
Knowledge of OT cybersecurity initiatives and best practices.
Familiarity with backup and recovery procedures for OT systems.

Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to support challenges.

You encourage others to think differently, providing an environment where creativity and new ideas are welcomed. I am keen to help deliver new initiatives, providing feedback on how they could be further improved
A humble leader who lives the Tesco’s values
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren’t limited to:
Competitive Salary from €37,500
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2
nd
Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*

Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move.  Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”.  Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers.  It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated.   At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings.  We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.

The role would provide dedicated ownership for implementing and sustaining 6S across laboratories areas. Key accountabilities would include programme coordination, workplace assessments, visual standards, audits, action tracking, training, coaching and performance reporting.

jobs.desc:
STA Design Engineer - ASIC / Low Power
We are partnered with a global leader in semiconductors and wireless technology focused on developing high-performance, low-power ASIC solutions for advanced cores and SOCs (System-on-Chips). The team are looking to hire an STA Engineer to take responsibility for conducting complex timing signoff activities and drive closure for next-generation products.
This is a permanent working opportunity based in Cork, Ireland.
Key responsibilities for this STA Design Engineer position:
Perform Static Timing Analysis (STA) and drive timing closure for complex cores and full-chip SOCs (e.g., in the Snapdragon family).
Evaluate block-level and top-level timing on gate-level PNR netlists.
Provide critical feedback to the RTL, Synthesis, and Physical Design teams to improve Power, Performance, and Area (PPA).
Create and execute Timing Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) to resolve critical timing violations.
Enhance techniques and methodologies for timing closure and STA flow accuracy to reduce turnaround time (TAT).
Develop automation scripts (Python, TCL, or Perl) for timing/power data mining and processing.
Key requirements:
4+ years of related work experience in Static Timing Analysis.
Expert proficiency in STA tools such as PrimeTime, PrimeShield, or Tempus for hierarchical analysis in large SoCs.
Hands-on experience with ECO tools (e.g., Tweaker, PrimeClosure, PTECO, Tempus ECO) for timing closure.
Highly proficient in automation scripting using Python, TCL, or Perl.
Strong knowledge of the complete ASIC design flow (RTL-to-GDS).
Keywords:
STA Design Engineer / Static Timing Analysis / STA / Timing Closure / ASIC Design / SOC / PrimeTime / Tempus / Timing ECO / PPA Optimization / Gate-Level Netlist / Python / TCL / Physical Design / RTL / Synthesis / Semiconductor / High-Performance Cores

Governed by a voluntary Board of Directors, STDC is managed by a Senior Management Team led by the Chief Executive Officer and currently comprising the Chief Executive Officer, Financial Controller and Social Inclusion Programme Manager.
STDC employs 42 core staff and 170 participants between the Tús programme and Rural Social Scheme. STDC delivers a diverse portfolio of employment services, labour market activation, social inclusion, rural and community development, health and wellbeing, integration and rural recreation programmes.
Purpose of the Role
This is a newly created senior management position at a pivotal stage in STDC’s development. The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping the organisation’s workforce, supporting and developing staff, promoting a positive work environment, strengthening organisational capacity and contributing to the delivery of employment and progression service programmes. The post offers an opportunity to influence both people strategy and service delivery as a member of the Senior Management Team.
The role involves the following key elements:
Human Resources
In association with the board and the CEO, the postholder will be responsible for recruitment, employee relations, staff development, promoting a positive working environment, policy development and employment law compliance, and ensuring that the organisation has the staffing capacity required to deliver its programmes into the future.
Employment Services
The postholder will manage assigned Employment Services programmes (e.g. LAES, Tús, Community Employment) with responsibility for programme delivery, staff performance, compliance and achievement of agreed targets.
Key Responsibilities
1. Human Resources
In association with the board and CEO, lead and manage STDC’s Human Resources function.
Ensure compliance with employment legislation, HR policies and organisational procedures.
Lead workforce planning, succession planning and the identification of future staffing and skills requirements.
Support Senior Management Team (SMT) in dealing with employee relations, performance, grievance and disciplinary matters.
Advise the Chief Executive Officer and Senior Management Team on employee and workforce matters and employment legislation.
Develop and implement a formal HR strategy aligned with organisational objectives
Oversee recruitment, induction, probation and staff exit processes.
Identify organisational training needs and lead the implementation of organisation-wide staff development programmes.
Ensure HR records, contracts, HR systems and workforce information are accurate, up-to-date and compliant.
2. Employment Services
Manage assigned Employment Services programmes e.g. LAES, Tús, etc
Lead, manage and support assigned programme staff, ensuring effective performance, development and accountability.
Monitor programme performance, compliance and achievement of agreed targets.
Ensure programmes operate in accordance with funder, contractual and organisational requirements.
Build and maintain relationships with funders, partners and other stakeholders.
Prepare programme reports, returns and funding claims as required.
Provide reports to the CEO and board as requested
3. Promote Positive Working Environment
Take a lead role in initiatives aimed at promoting and supporting positive working relations, including e.g. Employee assistance programme and wellbeing initiatives
Oversee the implementation of the Dignity at Work policy of STDC, working to ensure compliance and address any non-compliance.
4. Senior Management Team Responsibilities
Contribute to the work of the SMT
Support organisational planning, policy development and service improvement.
Support auditing, monitoring and quality assurances processes
Maintain accurate documentation and records in line with GDPR and regulatory requirements
Prepare reports and papers for the Board and CEO as requested
Represent STDC on various forums / committees as requested
Essential Requirements
Candidates must demonstrate:
A Level 8 qualification in Human Resource Management, Management, Business, Organisational Development or a related discipline.
Significant experience in human resource management and employee relations.
Strong knowledge of Irish employment legislation and HR best practice.
Experience managing programmes, projects or services and delivering agreed outcomes.
Experience advising and supporting managers on performance management, attendance management, grievance and disciplinary matters.
Experience leading recruitment, induction, probation and staff development processes.
Experience developing, implementing and reviewing HR policies and procedures.
Experience managing confidential and sensitive employment matters.
Experience preparing reports, recommendations and briefing papers for senior management and/or boards.
Experience managing staff and leading teams.
Strong leadership, communication, influencing and interpersonal skills.
Ability to operate effectively as a member of a Senior Management Team and contribute to organisational planning and decision-making.
Excellent organisational, administrative and IT skills.
Full driving licence and access to transport.
Desirable Requirements
Relevant level 9 professional qualification and/or membership of the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (CIPD).
Experience working in the community, voluntary, charitable or local development sector.
Experience of publicly funded programmes and services.
Experience managing employment, labour market activation or progression services.
Knowledge of Employment programmes such as Local Area Employment Services, Tús and Community Employment Scheme.
Experience working with Government departments, statutory agencies and programme funders.
Experience supporting Boards of Directors and Board sub-committees.
Experience in organisational development, service improvement or change management.
Experience using HR, CRM or workforce information systems.
Salary and Conditions
Competitive salary aligned to senior management roles within the local development sector and commensurate with qualifications and experience.
30 days annual leave (per Calander year)
Contributory pension benefits
Mileage paid at public service rates
Flexible / hybrid working arrangements
Professional Development Support
Access to Employee Assistance Programme
Supportive organisational culture

We are committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, race, membership of the Traveller community or socio-economic background.

About Glanua
Glanua is an industry leader in providing innovative and sustainable engineering solutions to design, build, operate and maintain critical water and wastewater infrastructure across Ireland and the UK. We are a trusted delivery partner to the municipal and industrial sector, and our clients include some of the largest water utilities in Ireland and the UK, including Uisce Éireann (formerly Irish Water), Thames Water, Yorkshire Water and Affinity Water.
We are passionate about solving today's environmental challenges and delivering a decarbonised, sustainable world. We know that to build successful, creative teams we need a diverse workforce that brings new ways of thinking, and we provide an environment where you have the freedom to develop and grow to your full potential. We champion our core values and uphold the highest standards of Safety and Well-being, Innovation, Integrity, Collaboration, Courage, Agility, Accountability, Diversity and Inclusion in everything we do.
We are a team of 600+ people across Ireland, the UK and Portugal and are rapidly expanding across several disciplines to meet our ambitious growth plans.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Automation & Controls Engineer to join our Automation Team at senior level. You will design, programme and deliver PLC, HMI and SCADA solutions for water treatment, wastewater treatment and energy projects across Ireland and the UK, covering greenfield plants and major upgrades involving technologies such as RO, MBR, SBR, MBBR, DAF, tertiary treatment, sludge handling, network telemetry and pumping stations.
This is a hands-on, full-lifecycle role combining technical delivery with strategic package management: tendering, functional design, software development, FAT, on-site control systems commissioning and testing, SAT and handover. You will own the automation and EC&I scope on assigned projects, acting as the technical lead and primary interface between the client, our project teams, and external Automation System Integrators (SIs), panel builders and instrumentation suppliers. You will manage the full supplier lifecycle, from selection and contracting through to design review, FAT witnessing and commissioning support, while also developing and building PLC code, HMI and SCADA solutions directly where required.
You will work inside a multi-disciplinary team alongside process, mechanical, electrical and project management colleagues, in a genuine "one team" culture, with the autonomy to develop ideas, shape internal standards and introduce new technology. You will work closely with the Electrical Design department on MCC schedules, motor lists, VSD specifications and overall EC&I integration.

This breadth gives exposure to municipal water and wastewater, industrial treatment, operations-focused delivery and renewable energy / biogas projects. You'll work alongside experienced peers on landmark schemes, with the autonomy to shape internal standards, contribute to engineering decisions on major capital projects, and introduce new technology into our delivery. Glanua is a place that invests in its engineers, through CPD, technical specialisation and breadth of project responsibility.

8+ years' experience in automation, ICA, I&C or control systems engineering, with significant exposure to the water, wastewater, desalination or utilities sector. (We will consider strong candidates with 5+ years where the project portfolio is exceptional.)
Degree (or equivalent) in Automation, Control & Instrumentation, Electrical/Electronic, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline, with demonstrable Automation, Control & Instrumentation content.
Proven competence on at least one major PLC platform: Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider or Mitsubishi.
Proven competence on at least one major SCADA platform: AVEVA, Ignition, Iconics or Vijeo Citect.
Hands-on experience commissioning VSDs and instrumentation, and integrating them into control systems.
Strong on-site commissioning track record for automated control systems, including PLC/SCADA loop checkout, end-to-end I/O testing, control loop commissioning, plant start-up and client handover.
Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols: EtherNet/IP, Profinet, Profibus, Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, DeviceNet.
Experience producing FDS, SDS, FAT and SAT documentation to international standards.
Knowledge of applicable codes and regulations; experience working to UK / EU / IEC standards is an advantage.
Excellent problem-solving, fault-finding and analytical skills, with the ability to use your own initiative when issues arise during project delivery.
Strong written and verbal English, comfortable presenting technical solutions to clients and chairing review meetings.
Demonstrable project engineering, package management or technical-coordination experience in automation, EC&I or systems integration; water/wastewater or another regulated process sector preferred.
Demonstrable experience managing technical subcontractors and the supply chain, including Automation System Integrators, panel builders, instrumentation suppliers.
Strong working knowledge of at least one major PLC platform (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider or Mitsubishi), sufficient to credibly review SI design deliverables, challenge technical decisions and resolve issues in detailed design and FAT.
Strong working knowledge of at least one major SCADA platform (AVEVA, Ignition, Iconics) at architecture and design level.
Solid working understanding of the electrical interface, including MCCs, VSDs, soft starters, field instrumentation and cable design, to coordinate effectively with the Electrical Design team.
Excellent technical document review skills, including FDS, SDS, schedules, network drawings, P&IDs.
Strong client-facing communication, both written and verbal; confident chairing design reviews and resolving technical issues across multiple stakeholders.
Practical awareness of project programme, scope, change management and the commercial implications of technical decisions on EC&I packages.
Full driving licence (or eligibility to obtain an Irish/EU driving licence on relocation).
Desirable:
Direct delivery experience on water or wastewater treatment plants, including RO desalination, MBR, SBR, MBBR, DAF, tertiary treatment and sludge handling, or on telemetry and SCADA for water networks.
Experience integrating to enterprise SCADA / historian environments (e.g. AVEVA Historian, PI System).

jobs.title: Seasonal Operator - Charleville
jobs.desc:
We are currently recruiting for a
Seasonal Operator
at our Kinisla site in Charleville, Co. Cork.
This is a full-time, seasonal position, with rotating day (08:00-16:00), evening (16:00-00:00), and night (00:00-8:00) shifts. During periods of increased demand, opportunities for overtime and weekend work will be available with increased pay rate. The season lasts from mid-January to November.
As a Seasonal Operator, you'll play a key role in our operations, with the chance to work in different areas of our site depending on your skills and training. Any previous experience as a production operative, warehouse operative, forklift operative, line operative or machine operator will be an advantage.
What will I be doing?
Working as part of a team in production areas, ensuring smooth and efficient manufacturing processes
Operating machinery and equipment safely and effectively
Adhering to health and safety guidelines
Assisting with quality control checks on ingredients and finished products
Supporting continuous improvement initiatives
Maintaining accurate production records
What do I need to be successful?
You will be a dependable team player who is motivated by the ability to add value and by championing collaboration and teamwork
You will show great attention to detail, helping to maintain efficient production processes and high-quality standards
You will have great communication skills, demonstrate fluency in English, and show motivation to learn
Experience in food manufacturing environment will be an advantage
What will I get in return?
At Kinisla, we believe in giving talented, curious people the opportunity to make a difference. We work as a team, searching for the best ways to inspire food and nourish life. We are a community of innovators, working across disciplines to solve global food challenges with a fresh approach. We want you to achieve whatever you put your mind to.
We also offer:
Career development opportunities
Employee benefit platform with discounts and offers for retailers online and offline, travelling, utilities and more
Matched pension scheme up to 10%
Employee Assistance Program, supporting your emotional, physical, nutritional and financial wellbeing
MyCommunity, have one day per year to volunteer for a worthwhile cause
Friendly team focused on continuous improvements and safety
About Kinisla
Kinisla is a vertically integrated farm-to-fork business with a very substantial consumer foods presence and a leading nutritional and dairy ingredients division, delivering high-quality dairy solutions with a focus on sustainability and innovation. From partnering with local family farms to producing world-class dairy products, we ensure every step of our value chain reflects our commitment to excellence.
With over 50 years' experience in milk processing, dairy and nutritional technology advancement, and product innovation, we are a key stakeholder in the global food industry and creators of a strong portfolio of market leading dairy brands including Cheestrings, Charleville and Coleraine Cheese, Dairygold, Golden Cow and our new SMUG range. Our from food, for food culture and deep-rooted connection to our 2,800 milk suppliers differentiates our business and offers captivating opportunities for our customers and consumers.
Our dairy comes from some of the world's richest grazing land and is produced by a network of Irish family farms that have one of the lowest carbon footprints in the world. Through a combination of expertise, innovation, and sustainability, Kinisla is proud to shape the future of dairy while meeting the diverse needs of our farmers, customers, and communities.
Headquartered in Tralee, Co. Kerry, we operate multiple manufacturing facilities in the southwest of Ireland, including Listowel, Charleville, Newmarket, and Farranfore. Additionally, we manage 29 Farm & Home stores throughout the region, ensuring comprehensive coverage and service. In Northern Ireland and the United Kingdom, our presence extends to key locations in Portadown, Coleraine, and Ossett.
Globally, Kinisla employs over 1,600 dedicated professionals across Ireland, Northern Ireland, the UK, USA, Netherlands, Spain, Germany, and China. In 2024, we achieved a turnover of approximately €1.3 billion, reflecting our commitment to excellence and growth.
Get in touch today!
In Kinisla we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. We are committed to nurturing an environment of positivity and inclusiveness, where everyone can be at their best, both personally and professionally.
Our recruitment, selection and assessment process are based on the skills and competencies of the specific roles and based entirely on merit. We are committed to and value Diversity and Inclusion in all recruitment processes within Kinisla and do not discriminate based on gender, race, class, economic status, ethnic background, sexual orientation, age, political beliefs, veteran status, marital status or any other protected characteristic.
Beware of scams online or from individuals claiming to represent us. A Kinisla employee will not solicit candidates through a non-Kinisla email address or phone number. In addition, Kinisla does not currently utilise video chat rooms (e.g., Google Hangouts) to conduct interviews. Refuse any request that asks you to provide payment to participate in the hiring process (e.g., purchasing a "starter kit," investing in training, or something similar). Kinisla will not ask you to pay any money at any point in the hiring process with the exception of reimbursable travel expenses. In addition, any payments made by Kinisla will be from official firm accounts bearing the Kinisla name.
Please note: We do not accept CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies where Kinisla terms of business have not been signed. Additionally, we will not consider or agree to payment of any recruiter fee under these circumstances. This also applies to CVs or candidate profiles sent directly to any Kinisla Hiring Managers.

jobs.title: Calibration Technician
jobs.desc:
LotusWorks is an Engineering Services provider specializing in managing Commissioning, Construction Services, Calibration, Operations & Maintenance scopes of work within global manufacturing facilities. LotusWorks operates globally across EMEA and North America partnering with the world's leading manufacturers across the Semiconductor, Pharmaceutical & Biologics, Medical Device and Data Center sectors. Our team of Engineering and Technical professionals is immersed in cutting-edge technologies and innovations. LotusWorks is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, integral to our people-first approach.
As a Calibration Technician, you will report directly to the Site Lead and carry out planned and unplanned calibration activities in line with the calibration schedule prepared by the Lead Calibration Technician. The role will have a strong focus on process calibrations, while also supporting gauging calibrations as required. You will ensure that all Inspection, Measurement and Test Equipment (IMTE) is calibrated safely, on time, and in accordance with site quality requirements, with accurate completion of calibration records and timely escalation of any calibration issues. Safety is a line responsibility, and all personnel are responsible for ensuring that work is conducted safely within their direct or indirect supervision.
Responsibilities
Operations & Maintenance
Complete assigned calibration activities in accordance with the schedule prepared by the Lead Calibration Technician, escalating any risks to completion or equipment availability.
Perform process calibrations including pressure transmitters, transducers, manometers, ovens, furnaces, temperature controllers, freezers, pH and conductivity equipment, cleanrooms, cleanlines, refractometers, ultrasonic baths, packaging equipment and other process instrumentation.
Support gauging calibrations, including calipers, micrometers, pin, plug and thread gauges, drop gauges, overlay and TAPPI charts, CMM calibrations and air gauging systems.
Execute planned and reactive calibration activities in a safe, timely and compliant manner, minimizing disruption to production.
Promptly escalate calibration failures, technical issues and any risks to equipment availability.
Quality
Ensure calibration work orders, as-found/as-left results and associated records are completed accurately and on time within the calibration system and in accordance with site standards.
Follow approved procedures and Equipment Work Instructions (EWIs).
Escalate out-of-tolerance or failed calibrations in accordance with site procedures.
Support discrepancy investigations and ensure required actions are completed.
Complete all required training and maintain audit-ready calibration documentation.
Governance & Relationship Management
Report directly to the Site Lead and work to the operational priorities established through the Lead Calibration Technician.
Escalate schedule, quality, safety and technical issues as required.
Maintain strong working relationships with onsite equipment owners and users to coordinate calibration activities and ensure equipment readiness and access.
Collaborate with Quality, EHS, Engineering, Maintenance, Production and Metrology teams to support compliant calibration execution and troubleshooting.
Provide clear and timely updates on calibration progress, equipment failures, delays and required actions.
Resource Management
Manage assigned daily calibration activities efficiently and complete work within agreed priorities and due dates.
Support other Calibration Technicians and participate in cross-training to improve flexibility and coverage across process and gauging activities.
Maintain and develop technical competence in process instrumentation, calibration standards, troubleshooting and site calibration procedures.
Support Functions
Support the creation, review and continuous improvement of Equipment Work Instructions (EWIs), calibration procedures, Calibration Record Forms (CRFs) and Calibration Data Forms (CDFs), where required.
Adhere to all site Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) requirements and the Life Without (LW) safety culture during all calibration activities.
Identify and support opportunities to improve calibration methods, workflow, equipment reliability, efficiency and compliance.
Any other duties or responsibilities that may be assigned to you in your role.
Skills Required
Practical experience in calibration, metrology, instrumentation or a related technical discipline.
Strong knowledge of process instrumentation and calibration principles.
Experience calibrating pressure, temperature, pH, conductivity and other process instrumentation.
Experience with gauging equipment and dimensional measurement techniques is desirable.
Ability to interpret technical procedures, Equipment Work Instructions (EWIs) and calibration documentation.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate documentation and data integrity.
Ability to identify, troubleshoot and escalate calibration failures and out-of-tolerance conditions.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple calibration activities and priorities.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with equipment owners and cross-functional teams.
Commitment to maintaining high standards of quality, safety and compliance.
Willingness to participate in cross-training and continued technical development.
Education / Licenses / Certifications
Minimum of Level 7 Qualification in Calibration/Engineering/Metrology or Process Instrumentation.
Proof of education, licenses, and certifications will be required where applicable

VHI Healthcare Cover
Life Assurance
Pension Contribution
Training And Educational Assistance
Annual GP Check-Up
Extra Annual Leave
Healthcare Screening
Recognition Rewards

jobs.title: Pre-Sales Solutions Architect – AI Agent & Workload Security
jobs.desc:
Tigera—the pioneer behind Calico and Lynx—is defining the future of AI agent security, workload governance, and cloud-native networking. As autonomous AI agents, LLM frameworks, and microservices proliferate across enterprise infrastructure, Tigera delivers the deep visibility, runtime protection, and eBPF-driven enforcement control required to secure the next generation of computing.
From modern cloud-native architectures to cutting-edge AI agent ecosystems, our technology safeguards over 1 million Kubernetes clusters across multicloud and hybrid environments. Trusted by world-class innovation leaders—including NVIDIA, Royal Bank of Canada, Bloomberg, Chipotle, GoDaddy, and Upwork—we empower enterprises to build, scale, and innovate with AI safely and without compromise.
At Tigera, our customers are the heroes of our story. We aim high, move fast, foster continuous learning, and build a high-trust, highly collaborative environment where every voice shapes the future of AI security. If you are looking to help make a substantial impact, and our values and products align with your vision of your career growth, we want to hear from you!
The Opportunity
AI agents are rapidly becoming the new runtime layer of the enterprise—and securing them is the next massive frontier in cybersecurity.
We are hiring a
Pre-Sales Solutions Architect
in
Cork, Ireland
, to serve as the technical champion for
Lynx
, our flagship solution designed specifically to secure autonomous AI agents and modern workloads. With customer demand skyrocketing and PoCs accelerating globally, you will be on the front lines of a brand-new product category.
You will partner closely with Account Executives, Product Management, and Marketing to guide prospective enterprises from initial architecture discussions through high-impact PoCs to closed-won deals. Additionally, you will work with our enterprise Calico accounts to unlock additional value by securing AI workloads.
This role is ideal for a forward-thinking pre-sales professional or platform/security engineer eager to spearhead AI agent security while the category is being defined. You don’t need to be an AI expert on day one—if you bring strong Kubernetes and application security foundations along with a passion for how AI systems are built, we will help you build the required expertise.
The role will be hybrid based out of our Cork city office.
You Will
Drive AI & Workload Security Deals: Lead the technical discovery, live demonstrations, solution architecture, and proof-of-concept (PoC) executions for Lynx across top-tier enterprise prospects.
Shape AI Security Requirements: Partner directly with prospects to discover how they build, deploy, and connect AI agents, and help them convert runtime patterns into concrete security and governance policies using Lynx.
Build Reusable Assets: Design and maintain state-of-the-art Lynx demo environments, PoC playbooks, and architecture blueprints to increase deal velocity.
Influence the Product Roadmap: Serve as the strategic feedback loop between the field and product engineering. Capture customer requirements, highlight market shifts, and directly influence the evolution of Lynx.
Champion the AI Security Movement: Represent Tigera as an author and speaker. Deliver technical webinars, lead workshops, participate in meetups/conferences, and publish insights on securing AI agents.
Master Technical Execution: Lead technical RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaire validations, and internal enablement sessions on AI agent security.
Guide Strategic Enterprise Accounts: Act as the trusted technical advisor for a dedicated set of Calico accounts. Drive platform adoption, conduct technical architecture reviews, and uncover expansion opportunities into Lynx.
Travel: Connect in person with enterprise clients and attend industry events across Europe (approx. 25% travel).
You Have
Pre-Sales or Hands-On Engineering Experience: 3 to 6 years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant) OR hands-on experience in platform, DevOps, or cloud security engineering with a driven desire to launch a career in pre-sales.
Core Cloud-Native Foundations: Strong, hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized architectures. You can comfortably stand up clusters, troubleshoot complex workloads, and explain core container runtime mechanics.
Security Discipline: Deep understanding of modern application and cloud security principles, including Zero Trust models, network policies, identity-based security, and cloud access controls.
Identity & Token Knowledge: Practical understanding of identity-first security—how JWTs are structured, signed, and validated; working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and mTLS mechanics.
Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Sales Acumen: Sales skills such as active listening, MEDDPICC alignment and ability to translate features into business value.
Exceptional Communication: Natural ability to translate complex AI runtime mechanics and Zero Trust architectures into clear, compelling narratives for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.
Startup Mindset: Curious, self-driven, and excited by the opportunity to own and establish leadership in an emerging category.
Nice to Have (Bonus Points)
Hands-on exposure to building or securing AI/LLM applications or agents (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or Model Context Protocol / MCP servers).
Familiarity with workload identity frameworks (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE) or API gateways / service meshes (Istio, Envoy).
Prior experience with Calico, Cilium, OpenShift, or eBPF technology.
Familiarity with emerging AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF).
Proficiency in a second European language.
Why Join Tigera?
Be at the Forefront of AI: Build your career at the intersection of eBPF, Kubernetes, and AI agent security.
Global Impact, Local Hub: Join a vibrant hub in Cork, Ireland, backed by global offices in San Francisco, San Jose, Vancouver, and London.
Comprehensive Compensation & Benefits: Highly competitive salary, sales incentive plans, and comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.
Culture of Growth & Autonomy: Work alongside industry experts who value openness, continuous learning, bold execution, and genuine team support.
With offices in San Francisco, San Jose, Vancouver (Canada), Cork (Ireland), and London (England), we have a thriving team of diverse individuals from all over the world. We believe in a collaborative, flexible work environment based on respect for, and commitment from, every employee. We also offer a competitive compensation package along with full health, vision, and dental benefits. These benefits, coupled with an amazing team of individuals who believe in our mission and value openness, collaboration, and teamwork, make Tigera an awesome place to work.

Company Overview
Carbery Group is dedicated to enriching lives. How do we do this? Owned by the farmers of West Cork, we are a global business with deep local roots. Our mission is to deliver lasting value to our farmer shareholders while making positive impact on our customers, employees, suppliers, partners, and the communities we serve. We are committed to doing this by creating healthier, tastier, and more sustainable food and ingredient solutions.
With customers in over 50 countries, we pride ourselves on our commitment to innovation, our open mindset and ability to be a good partner. We prioritise our customers' needs, while also valuing our planet and fostering a thriving, people-first environment.
Your Role in Carbery's Success
As an Applied AI Technology Specialist, you will work closely with the group CIO to ensure that Carbery genuinely keeps current with how AI is evolving. You will bring deep, current knowledge of the AI landscape and test what is genuinely worth pursuing, while working alongside the senior team to help bring proven ideas into the business.
How You Will Contribute
Continuously track emerging AI models, tools, research and practitioner practice, and translate that into a short, opinionated shortlist of what's genuinely relevant to Carbery.
Build and run small, hands-on prototypes against genuine internal business problems, reaching a clear keep-or-kill verdict on each.
Say no, clearly and in writing, to AI trends that are hype-driven or don't fit Carbery's data and regulatory reality — as often as flagging things worth pursuing.
Own the transition of proven concepts from pilot to full production scale, in partnership with the Digital team and whoever will operate the solution day to day.
Present evidence-based updates at agreed Group Leadership Team sessions, scoped to what has actually been tested and what's being scaled
Manage a budget for licences, prototyping tools and short-term experimentation.
Build the business case for scaling proven pilots into production, jointly with the Group CIO.
Essential Requirements
Meaningful experience (4+ years) in an AI, data, software or automation role, with direct hands-on build experience, not only strategy or advisory exposure.
A demonstrable habit of following AI developments closely — able to speak specifically to what's changed recently
Strong working knowledge of the LLM/SLM landscape, plus awareness of domain-specific and open-source alternatives.
Practical experience building and testing prototypes, proofs of concept or small tools in a real business setting, and taking at least one through to production or live use.
Genuinely immersed in the evolving AI landscape; new models, tools and techniques and able to separate what's real from what's well-marketed.
Clear, confident communication skills, able to present tested findings to senior stakeholders and contribute to strategic direction alongside a more senior sponsor.
Desirable Requirements
A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field.
Exposure to manufacturing or FMCG environments.
Our Commitment to our People
We are a diverse and growing workforce of over 1,000 people across eight countries globally. As we continue to grow, we want to ensure that Carbery Group continues to be a place where people are supported to develop and feel that they can do their best work. We are committed to driving growth, developing future capability and delivering results through our dedicated teams.
We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and an inclusive workplace where your skills, perspectives, and experience help shape the future of our industry. Join us and be part of a team that values collaboration and makes a meaningful impact - from local communities to global markets.
Carbery Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to fostering a supportive work environment.

jobs.desc:
About the role
We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services.
But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are.
Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work.
Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date.
You will be responsible for
Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do.
Get to know your customers and serve them with pride.
Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times.
Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition.
Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times.
Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes.
Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines.
Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments.
You will need
Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers.
Works hard for customers, your team and your department.
You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers.
Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business.
You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written.
You are reliable and a good timekeeper.
You must be smart and tidy at all times.
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/

Please let us know you need additional support by emailing tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie
This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

Christmas Sales Advisor
Love connecting with customers? Absolutely thrive in a team? Ready to join Rituals during the most festive time of year?
This might be the perfect seasonal job for you.
Join us during our busiest and most magical time of year. As our Christmas Temp, you'll work in a beautifully decorated boutique that's filled with holiday joy. You're doing much more than selling products or giving customers a quick 'hello' and 'goodbye'. You'll create what we call the Feel Good Experience: our way of making customers feel amazing during the most wonderful time of the year.
What You’ll Be Doing
Deliver the Feel Good Experience - welcome customers with our signature tea, help them find their favourite products or surprise them with something they never knew they needed.
Hit sales targets - stay sharp on the numbers and challenge yourself with small victories, like perfecting a product story or turning more customers into members.
Handle all the retail essentials - you run the register, take deliveries, and keep the boutique looking sharp and stocked at all times.

Christmas Rootcamp: our onboarding programme where we teach you everything about working at Rituals during the holidays.

Growth opportunities including The Book of Rituals (our learning platform) and coaching on the job to help you grow.

It’s an exciting time for our Ports, Coastal & Offshore Teams with major project success and workload growth. Mott MacDonald is one of the global leaders in maritime, advising a broad range of clients:
In the planning, design and construction of a range of ports and other marine terminal infrastructure
With development of sustainable solutions for our coastlines

Join us to shape the future of ports, coastal and offshore energy in Ireland. We are looking to appoint a Principal Maritime Engineer with experience in the Irish market who will join our Team and grow our portfolio in Ireland.

The Planning team ensures that the entire Product Operations Org understands, and can execute, the current and future demand requirements across the multiple lines of business in which we operate. They ensure that all customer orders can be fulfilled on time by aligning all key components in the supply chain. As the Planning Manager, you will ensure that our strategies deliver an exceptional customer experience through efficient and predictable execution. You will continuously challenge the status quo, developing and implementing strategies that allow the business to scale effectively.

Lead and develop an experienced planning team, ensuring all operational KPIs are consistently met.
Develop and implement scalable strategies and process improvements to support business growth and ensure timely execution.
Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Demand Management, Logistics and other cross-functional teams to drive strategic supply chain initiatives across Cork and Europe.
Analyse complex data and large datasets to inform strategic decisions and tactical execution.
Present data, strategies, and complex subjects clearly to diverse audiences across multiple functions and leadership levels.
Evaluate and optimize existing toolsets, collaborating with relevant teams to ensure the right capabilities and knowledge are in place.
Drive innovation and report automation to improve team efficiency and continually challenge the status quo.
Minimum Qualifications
Demonstrated people management experience in production planning, logistics, supply chain, or a closely related field.
Demonstrated experience working with large datasets, analyzing numbers, and using data to drive decision-making.
Self-driven and enthusiastic leadership style with a proven track record of delivering results and leading projects to implementation.
Ability to think strategically and execute tactically with persistent attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences.
High degree of initiative, flexibility, and comfort working both independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications

jobs.desc:
Come join the Server Ingress Security team, where we are rearchitecting MongoDB Server’s ingress networking to make MongoDB clusters even more secure. This new team is building the Atlas Network Protection layer, a set of performant, security-critical services that harden MongoDB's pre-authentication attack surface and provides the ability to respond rapidly to emergent threats. We are looking for talented Senior Engineers to join the team and be founding members, where you will play a crucial role in our multi-year roadmap.
Our team champions a strong culture of inclusivity, diversity, and collaboration. If you want to work on a collaborative team that applies security and systems engineering fundamentals to protect a popular database at scale, join us!
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.
Candidate Profile
5+ years of experience building production-quality systems software
Experience with large backend/compiled codebases and performance-sensitive software, preferably in Rust
Bonus points for experience working hands-on in security-sensitive or networking-adjacent domains
Strong systems fundamentals, including multi-threaded programming and performance profiling. Bonus points for:
Understanding of network protocols, TLS, and connection lifecycle management
Familiarity with security concepts such as attack surface reduction, input validation, memory safety, and defense-in-depth architectures
Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills, with a strong desire to collaborate with colleagues
Strong time management skills and the ability to realistically assess project complexity
B.Sc. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design/architecture. Interest in the theory and practice of high-availability, security-critical systems
Position Expectations
Design, implement, and operate production-ready security services in Rust, with a focus on security, correctness, performance, and operational excellence
Develop ingress networking and security solutions that ensure the security, availability, and performance of a database service
Diagnose test failures and performance regressions, and implement fixes
Lead development and project management for features and initiatives within the Ingress Security domain
Collaborate across Server, Atlas, Drivers, SRE, and Product Security teams to ensure the Atlas Network Protection layer integrates seamlessly with the broader MongoDB ecosystem
Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering leadership to define the team's roadmap
Success Measures
In the first month: Understand the high-level architecture of the Atlas Network Protection layer, set up your development environment, and resolve a few bugs
In three months: Contribute substantially to the Rust development of a current project or milestone, take on code review responsibilities, and participate in reviewing designs for new features
In six months: Independently lead the development of a new feature and help mentor new engineers on the team
In twelve months: Drive significant improvements to the security, performance, or operational capabilities of the Ingress Security stack, and contribute to the long-term technical roadmap of the team

Role Overview
This is a hybrid role based in our Cork office.
As a Staff Engineer on NETGEAR’s AI Platform and Enablement team, you will play a strategic and highly impactful role in shaping how AI is built into the fabric of the whole company: engineering teams, business units and corporate functions alike. This position is designed for a deeply experienced technical leader who thrives at the intersection of AI infrastructure, developer enablement and business enablement.
You will own three interconnected areas of ownership. First, you will help build and operate the core AI and LLM platform: model routing, evaluation, and the shared tooling that lets teams across NETGEAR build reliably on top of large language models. Second, you will scale the use of coding agents and assistants across engineering, raising AI fluency and the bar on how we ship software. Third, and equally important, you will extend AI enablement beyond engineering and into business functions — finding the workflows worth automating and building them.
That third mandate is not a side project. A meaningful share of NETGEAR’s near-term AI value sits in business process, not product code, and this role is expected to have organisation-wide impact. Much of the work will resemble the enablement currently being driven for non-technical teams, scaled up and made repeatable.
With significant autonomy, you will own delivery of key technical initiatives aligned with organisational goals and directly influence the short and medium-term success of NETGEAR’s AI strategy.
Key Responsibilities
AI and LLM Platform Infrastructure
Design, build, and operate the shared AI platform layer: model routing and fallback strategies, API gateway patterns, rate limiting, and multi-provider abstraction (Anthropic, OpenAI, and others as needed).
Own cost and usage optimisation across the organisation’s AI spend, covering model selection, prompt and context efficiency, caching, and session-level cost controls.
Build evaluation, observability, and monitoring for LLM-powered features and agents, including quality regression detection and usage analytics.
Define architecture and standards for secure, scalable integration of AI capabilities into product and internal systems, including authentication, data handling, and compliance considerations.
Engineering AI Enablement
Drive adoption and effective use of AI coding agents and assistants (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) across engineering teams.
Build internal tooling, guardrails, and workflows (agentic SDLC patterns, managed agents, review and QA processes) that let engineers safely delegate more work to AI.
Establish best practices, documentation, and training that raise the AI fluency of the wider engineering organisation.
Business and Functional Enablement

Own delivery of end-to-end initiatives that bridge platform infrastructure, developer tooling, business process and product engineering.
Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and system debugging across multiple layers of the platform.
Provide mentorship and guidance to engineers and functional champions working with AI tools and platform services, nurturing a culture of technical excellence and responsible AI use.
Establish and track clear objectives, delivering measurable results aligned with quarterly goals and reporting on AI-driven productivity gains and cost efficiency across the organisation.

8+ years of software engineering experience, with a demonstrated history of leading impactful technical initiatives.
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) in production, including prompt and context design, tool use, and agentic workflows.
Demonstrated ability to simplify complexity: taking a tangled business flow or legacy process, understanding it end to end, and reducing it to something clear, reliable and automatable. A track record of continuously exploring new tools and techniques in a fast-moving field.

Strong track record of cost, performance, and reliability optimisation in cloud or distributed systems, with a proven ability to influence business outcomes through technology decisions.
Experience building or operating internal developer platforms, APIs, or shared infrastructure used by multiple teams.
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and a genuine interest in scaling their use across an organisation.

jobs.title: Development Manager, AI Transformation & Innovation

Overview
This is a high-impact role with a mandate to change how Quest builds software, operates as a business, and innovates its product portfolio.
You will lead a team of ten software engineers, data scientists and data engineers across three connected areas:
AI-first software development: Roll out and continuously improve an AI-first development lifecycle (AI-DLC) across Quest Engineering.
Business transformation: Lead data science and engineering initiatives with the CIO, Finance and other functions to automate processes and turn Quest’s data into actionable insight.
Innovation: Build and validate AI-driven prototypes that can differentiate Quest and be adopted across the product portfolio.
The team will have scope to grow as it demonstrates impact, creating an opportunity for the role to expand significantly.
Responsibilities
AI-first software development
Lead the design, rollout and adoption of AI-DLC across Quest Engineering, working with development leaders across locations and portfolios.
Drive adoption through practical workflows, playbooks, onboarding, champions and hands-on support.
Establish responsible-use guardrails covering quality, security, licensing, IP and data.
Continuously evolve the approach as AI models and tooling develop.
Manage AI consumption and budget, including monitoring, model selection, routing and cost controls.
Measure and report engineering productivity and team health using metrics such as throughput, cycle time, quality, defects and engineer experience.
Build a high-performance team with clear accountability and a strong reputation across engineering.
Data science and business transformation
Own a roadmap of AI and automation initiatives across the business, prioritising opportunities based on value and capacity.
Partner with the CIO, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Product to identify and deliver high-value use cases.
Turn Quest’s existing data into commercially useful insight, including initiatives such as customer churn and propensity modelling.
Build the data engineering foundations required to scale this work, including pipelines, data quality, governance and access.
Ensure models and insights influence real business decisions rather than becoming standalone analyses or dashboards.
Manage privacy, security and compliance considerations in partnership with the relevant functions.
Innovation
Lead a small, fast-moving prototyping capability focused on commercially meaningful innovation.
Identify , prototype and validate AI use cases for the Quest product portfolio.
Prioritise reusable capabilities that can benefit multiple products.
Work with Product and Architecture to create a clear path from successful prototype to product adoption.
Stop initiatives that do not demonstrate sufficient value and continuously monitor the external technology and competitive landscape.
Qualifications
Essential
Experience leading a team of 8–10 software developers using an AI-first development methodology .
5–8 years’ experience as a first-line manager.
Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
Strong technical credibility across software engineering and/or data science.
Experience working with multiple stakeholders across a business.
Track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to senior leadership and non-technical audiences.
Preferred
Experience managing or working closely with data scientists and data engineers.
Understanding of AI development economics, including token consumption, model selection and cost management.
Experience with engineering productivity metrics such as DORA.
Experience delivering machine learning or data science solutions into production.
Experience with enterprise data platforms, pipelines and governance.
Experience leading organisational change without direct authority.
Enterprise software or B2B SaaS experience.
Experience building and scaling a team from a small starting point.
What success looks like in the first 12 months
AI-DLC: Adopted beyond the pilot, with repeatable enablement for new teams.
Productivity: Trusted data demonstrates the health and productivity of engineering teams and identifies measurable improvement.

jobs.title: Analyst/Sr. Analyst - Global HR Solutions - Compliance & AI Governance
jobs.desc:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
This role supports compliance for HR Solutions across a defined set of countries. It contributes to what controls need to be in place, checks that they are working, supports in spotting where the risks are, and keeps the approach up to date as HR uses more AI. It also supports the process for reviewing, approving and monitoring AI and automation used across the employee lifecycle. The role is accountable for checking controls against the agreed standard but does not run the day-to-day controls or deliver the technology.
Key Responsibilities
Compliance framework
Contributes to the design, coherence and effectiveness of the HR Solutions compliance framework end to end, alongside HRS leadership — access management, business continuity, integrity assessment, documentation control and personnel history file governance.
Contribute to the scope, standard and cadence for recurring control activity and help assure the quality of delivery.
Support in maintaining a current view of compliance risk across defined set of regions, escalating and highlighting where local legal, works council or data protection requirements diverge from the global standard.
Identify control gaps arising from process, system or organisational change and advocate for remediation, supporting those remediation activities to closure with accountable owners.
Act as internal point for compliance judgement calls, escalating where needed, and maintain the documented rationale for positions taken.
AI and automation governance
Support the HR Solutions AI governance framework, aligned to best practise, and integrated with enterprise privacy and cyber requirements.
Maintain the register of AI and automated capabilities in use across HR Solutions, with risk tier, intended use, data accessed, accountable owner and review cadence.
Apply the assessment gate before any AI capability touches HR data or employee-facing processes, covering data minimisation, purpose limitation, decision transparency and mandatory human oversight points.
Assess the risks of every AI tool used in people decisions, keep those assessments up to date, and redo them whenever the tool or how it's used changes significantly.
Maintain the documentation a regulator or auditor would request, collected on a defined schedule rather than assembled reactively.
Run ongoing monitoring of AI-enabled processes in production — error patterns, drift, disparate outcomes across employee populations — with defined escalation thresholds.
Assess the risks of vendor AI tools before HR adopts them, including how they handle employee data and which countries' laws apply.
Provide independent challenge to automation proposals. Provide input and challenge on automation proposals from a compliance mindset.
Governance, assurance and capability
Advocate for HR Solutions compliance and assist in ensuring HR Solutions obligations under enterprise compliance, privacy and cyber frameworks are met.
Coordinate periodic assurance activities, including integrity assessment, BCP and BIA, ensuring the quality of what is submitted.
Provide compliance input of cyber security incident response where HR data or processes are affected.
Maintain an informed external view of regulatory direction and emerging practice in HR compliance and AI governance, and highlight any potential impact on the framework to HRS Leadership
Build compliance literacy across HR Solutions, including practical guidance on acceptable AI use in daily work.
Convert recurring findings into recommendations that support structural improvements rather than repeat remediation.
Interface with the DSAR Centre of Excellence
DSAR delivery sits outside this role. The compliance framework nonetheless sets the data protection and AI governance standard against which DSAR processing operates, including any AI applied to search or redaction.
Provide periodic assurance over DSAR decision defensibility and act as escalation point where a DSAR decision raises a framework-level question.
Qualifications & Experience
5+ years compliance, risk, audit or data protection experience in a regulated environment, ideally covering workforce data.
Working knowledge of GDPR applied across multiple jurisdictions, with practical understanding of where local variation materially changes the obligation.
Experience contributing to control framework design and operating effectively within one. Sufficient technical literacy to interrogate how an automated system reaches an output, what data it draws on and where it fails. Not an engineering role, but not one that can accept external assurances at face value.
Ability to hold a position under delivery pressure, and judgement to distinguish material risk from theoretical risk.
