jobs.title: DSP Engineer (Digital Signal Processing)
jobs.desc:
About MBRYONICS
MBRYONICS is at the forefront of free space optical communications. Our product portfolio covers a wide range of emerging technologies from photonic integrated circuits to advanced optical systems and embedded software solutions. Our optical communications systems are integrated and deployed in satellite communications systems. The work is exciting and challenging and is at the forefront of the technology domains. As part of our expansion, we are currently looking for a suitably motivated -
DSP Engineer
- to join our group.
As a Digital Signal Processing (DSP) Engineer at MBRYONICS, you'll be a key player on our engineering team, translating advanced communication theory into reality for our cutting-edge optical communication systems. This role is ideally suited for a fresh PhD graduate looking to transition deep academic expertise into high-impact, space-bound hardware. You will dive into algorithm design, system modeling, and cross-functional hardware integration in a fast-paced, high-tech setting.
What you'll do
Algorithm Development: Design and simulate advanced Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and Forward Error Correction (FEC) algorithms in both floating-point and fixed-point precision to optimize link performance, enhance functionality, and minimize power consumption.
Hardware Co-Design: Collaborate closely with the FPGA engineering team to provide clear fixed-point models and specifications, ensuring a smooth transition of your DSP algorithms into RTL implementation.
System Modeling: Develop comprehensive end-to-end models of analog RF and optical components (including lasers, modulators, photodetectors, and amplifiers) to accurately evaluate and predict system performance under real-world conditions.
Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with optical testing and firmware teams to create robust, automated algorithms for transceiver calibration, beam alignment, and run-time optimization in dynamic space environments.
Validation & Testing: Conduct system-level validation of your models against actual hardware performance, utilizing lab data to refine and iterate your designs.
Documentation: Document your algorithm architectures, simulation results, and fixed-point specifications to support the wider engineering lifecycle.
Who you are
Education: This role would be ideally suited to a Post Doctorate (or nearing completion) with a PHD in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a highly related field with a research focus on DSP or digital communications. We would also welcome applications from candidates with experience in industry rather than academia.
Simulation Mastery: Extensive hands-on experience using MATLAB and Simulink for complex modeling, system simulation, and algorithm development.
Theoretical Grounding: A deep, foundational understanding of digital communication theory, signal modulation, noise modeling, and error-correction techniques.
Fixed-Point Familiarity: Experience converting floating-point algorithms into optimized, bit-true fixed-point models suitable for FPGA or ASIC implementation (academic or project-based experience is highly valued).
Coding Skills: Proficiency in C/C++ or Python for scripting, data analysis, or rapid prototyping is a strong plus.
Problem-Solving Mindset: Strong analytical and mathematical skills, with the academic rigor required to tackle open-ended, complex engineering challenges.
Soft Skills & Passion: Excellent technical communication skills, a collaborative mindset eager to work across disciplines, and a genuine interest in space technology and free space optics.
What's In It For You
Career Growth:
Contribute to a world-class space-age communication program while developing your leadership skills in a state-of-the-art manufacturing environment
Collaboration:
Work with talented professionals across disciplines to drive impactful solutions
Innovation:
Be part of a team pioneering advancements in manufacturing engineering for cutting-edge FSO systems
Work-Life Balance:
Enjoy flexible work schedules and a comprehensive benefits package
If you're ready to take your career to new heights and drive the future of space-age communication, apply now and join the MBRYONICS team as our
D
SP Engineer
Diversity, Inclusion and Equal Opportunities
Core ethical values, diversity and inclusion are invaluable to MBRYONICS’ business success. We recognise that the broad perspectives that result from recruiting, developing and retaining a globally diverse workforce promotes innovation and helps us succeed as a business enterprise. It is the policy and practice of the Company to provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants. The Company will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, civil status, family status, disability, age, or membership of the Traveller community.
MBRYONICS is committed to providing a fair, accessible, and equitable recruitment process for everyone. If you require any assistance or a reasonable accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know.

This role is responsible for coordinating and continuously improving training and development activities within the Engineering function, ensuring compliance with company, regulatory, and legal requirements. jobs.title: Rail Programme Director
jobs.desc:
Company Description
Work with Us. Change the World.
At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
Job Description
AECOM is seeking a strategic and commercially driven Programme Director to lead the growth and delivery of major Rail & Transit programmes across Ireland. Reporting directly to the Transportation Ireland Sector Director and working closely with the Ireland Sector Leadership team and the Transportation Systems (Rail and Transit) Practice as well as AECOM’s global Transportation leadership, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping and delivering the sector’s 3-year growth strategy.
This role is focused on winning and delivering major projects, building high-value client relationships, and driving excellence in project performance, safety, and operational outcomes.
Here’s what you’ll do:
Strategic Growth & Work Winning
Support and drive the sector’s 3-year growth plan across UK & Ireland, in support of the Sector Director’s strategy
Lead positioning, client engagement, and bid activity to win opportunities ≥$5M, including early and enabling packages
Manage the end-to-end work winning process for major programmes
Define and implement the hybrid Enterprise Capability (EC) and. home country delivery model for bids
Enhance AECOM’s market presence and reputation with infrastructure owners, operators, and contractors
Collaborate with global teams to support growth across Europe and India through capability, knowledge, and resource sharing
Project & Client Leadership
Act as AECOM’s senior representative in the delivery of major programmes ≥$5M
Own and lead strategic client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and repeat business
Drive continuous improvement based on client feedback and performance outcomes
Lead collaboration with contractors, partners, and supply chain to ensure high-performing delivery teams
Delivery & Commercial Performance
Accountable for successful delivery of Sector owned projects, typically >$5M in revenue, ensuring performance across:
Schedule, cost, and quality
Project governance compliance
Drive strong commercial performance, including:
Sales bookings and revenue growth
Gross/net revenue and margin
Cashflow and DSO performance
Optimisation of EC utilisation
High-quality project data and reporting
Deliver programmes profitably and sustainably, aligned with business objectives
Leadership & Capability Development
Work within Transportation to build capability and capacity aligned to long-term growth
Lead collaboration across Business Lines, sectors, and geographies to unlock opportunities and strengthen delivery
Contribute to the development of a high-performing, globally connected team
Support the implementation of strategic workforce planning and resourcing models
Safety, Health, Environment & Wellbeing (SHE)
Champion and actively lead the SHE & Wellbeing agenda across all major projects
Ensure strong performance against both leading and lagging safety and sustainability metrics
Act as a visible safety leader, embedding best practice across delivery teams and partner organisations
Qualifications
Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?
Here’s what we’re looking for:
Proven market leader with a strong track record of positioning, leading, and winning major opportunities
Extensive experience delivering large-scale, multi-disciplinary infrastructure projects profitably
Demonstrated success working with infrastructure owners, operators, contractors, and partners
Strong commercial acumen with experience managing financial performance and project metrics
Experience operating within a global organisation, collaborating across sectors and geographies
Strong leadership capability, with a focus on developing teams and building long-term capability
Passionate about safety leadership, wellbeing, sustainable delivery, quality and innovation
Additional Information
Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.
To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
About AECOM
AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.
Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.
You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.
Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.
We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.desc:
About the role
We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services.
But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are.
Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work.
Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date.
You will be responsible for
Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do.
Get to know your customers and serve them with pride.
Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times.
Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition.

You will need
Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers.
Works hard for customers, your team and your department.
You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers.
Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business.
You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written.
You are reliable and a good timekeeper.
You must be smart and tidy at all times.
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. About The Role
The successful candidate will quickly assess the current cybersecurity landscape, identify operational and governance gaps, and implement disciplined, repeatable processes that drive measurable risk reduction.
Within the first 90 days, this leader is expected to establish clear visibility into cybersecurity risks, improve remediation accountability, accelerate resolution of critical and high vulnerabilities, strengthen patch governance, and create sustainable action plans that materially improve the security posture of the Enterprise Applications portfolio.
McKesson Technology is seeking a results-oriented Cybersecurity Leader to drive cybersecurity risk reduction across the Enterprise Applications portfolio.
This role is responsible for establishing scalable cybersecurity processes, accelerating vulnerability remediation, improving cyber governance, and partnering with our BISO and technology teams to proactively manage risk across a complex application landscape.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a proven ability to build processes from the ground up, rapidly assess gaps, and implement sustainable solutions that deliver measurable security improvements.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with BISO to lead cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, and risk reduction initiatives across the Enterprise Applications portfolio.
Establish and mature standardized processes for vulnerability assessment, remediation tracking, risk acceptance, exception management, and cybersecurity governance.
Analyze security trends, identify systemic issues, and implement corrective actions to reduce organizational risk.
Partner with application, engineering, infrastructure, architecture, and cyber teams to prioritize and remediate critical and high-risk vulnerabilities.
Develop and drive action plans to address security findings, ensuring accountability and timely execution.
Coordinate with portfolio, product, and finance teams to prioritize cybersecurity investments, projects, and funding requirements.
Implement metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting to monitor security posture, remediation progress, and operational effectiveness.
Drive automation of cybersecurity response, reporting, and governance processes wherever practical.
Lead long-term risk mitigation strategies for vulnerabilities that cannot be resolved through standard patching activities.
Foster a culture of security ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across technology teams.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Business, or related field.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in cybersecurity, technology risk management, technology operations, or enterprise application environments.
Experience managing cybersecurity programs across large-scale technology portfolios within multinational organizations.
Demonstrated success establishing cybersecurity governance, vulnerability management, and remediation processes.
Proven ability to assess complex environments, identify gaps, solve problems quickly, and implement repeatable operational processes.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Self-starter with a strong bias for action and accountability.
Preferred Qualifications
MBA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, or similar professional certifications.
Fortune 500, blue-chip, or large multinational company experience.
Experience automating cybersecurity workflows, reporting, and response processes.
Strong knowledge of vulnerability management, cyber risk management, patch management, security operations, and governance frameworks.
Experience partnering with software development and application teams to integrate security into delivery processes.
Working knowledge of Lean principles, continuous improvement methodologies, and operational excellence practices.

jobs.desc:
Overview
Are you an experienced ERP Resource Planning and Workforce Management professional looking to play a key role in a major business transformation programme?
PM Group is undertaking a significant enterprise-wide transformation through the implementation of a new Group ERP platform. As part of this strategic initiative, we are seeking an experienced ERP Resource Planning & Resource Management Workstream Lead to drive the design, implementation and optimisation of resource planning capabilities across the organisation.
This role will be responsible for ensuring that the ERP solution enables effective resource allocation, workforce planning, capacity management, utilisation tracking and forecasting across PM Group's project delivery organisation. The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Project Delivery, Finance, HR/HCM and implementation partners to establish future-state resource management processes, governance structures and reporting frameworks that support business growth and operational excellence.
This is a 12-month contract role and can be based in either our Dublin or Cork office, operating under a hybrid working model.
Responsibilities
ERP Resource Planning & System Implementation:
Lead the Resource Planning and Resource Management workstream throughout the ERP implementation lifecycle, from design and configuration through testing, deployment and business adoption.
Act as the primary business lead for resource planning, resource allocation, workforce management and capacity planning requirements within the ERP programme.
Partner with business stakeholders, functional leads, SMEs and implementation partners to define and validate resource management requirements and future-state processes.
Review solution designs, system configurations and evolving ERP builds to ensure alignment with business resource planning needs and operating model objectives.
Identify, assess and manage gaps between business requirements and standard ERP functionality, recommending appropriate configuration, process changes or system enhancements.
Define and validate reporting, analytics and dashboard requirements supporting resource planning, capacity forecasting, utilisation reporting and workforce demand management.
Support testing, training, change management and business readiness activities to ensure successful adoption of ERP resource planning capabilities.
Resource Management & Workforce Planning:
Design and implement resource planning processes that provide visibility of resource capacity, availability, skills, utilisation and future demand across the business.
Establish effective resource allocation and prioritisation processes that enable optimal deployment of project delivery resources.
Develop workforce planning frameworks that align organisational capability with current and future project demand.
Drive the implementation of resource forecasting, capacity planning and utilisation management processes within the ERP platform.
Partner with Operations, Project Delivery, Finance and HR to ensure resource planning data supports strategic decision-making and organisational growth plans.
Define and embed governance, controls and performance measures for resource management across the organisation.
Support the transition from implementation to ongoing operational management of resource planning processes and system capabilities.
Programme & Stakeholder Management:
Lead workstream planning, governance, reporting, risk management and issue resolution activities.
Coordinate dependencies and integration points across ERP workstreams including Finance, HCM, Projects and Reporting.
Engage senior stakeholders to drive alignment, decision-making and adoption of future-state resource management practices.
Provide regular progress updates, recommendations and escalation management throughout the programme lifecycle.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline.
Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent) would be advantageous.
10+ years' experience delivering ERP-enabled transformation programmes with significant responsibility for Resource Management, Workforce Planning, Resource Planning Systems or Project Portfolio Management functions.
Proven experience leading resource planning, capacity planning or workforce management workstreams within large ERP implementations.
Experience operating in engineering, professional services, consulting, construction, project-based or matrix organisations.
Strong understanding of:
Resource allocation and optimisation
Capacity and demand planning
Workforce planning and forecasting
Resource utilisation management
Skills and competency management
Resource governance and reporting
Project resource planning processes
Experience implementing, managing or optimising Resource Management, PPM, PSA or Workforce Planning solutions.
Experience with platforms such as Deltek, Workday, Planview, Clarity PPM, Oracle PPM, SAP PPM, SAP PS, Dynamics 365 Project Operations or similar resource planning systems would be highly advantageous.
Why PM Group?
Innovative Environment: Be part of a forward-thinking company driving digital innovation as part of an ambitious strategic growth agenda.
Collaborative Culture: Work in a collaborative and supportive team environment on an exciting transformational project.
We are an international project management firm with a team of 4000+ people and has been recognised for several successful projects. As an employee-owned company, we are inclusive, committed and driven. Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability are the heart of our new 2025 business strategy. Click here to read more in our
Corporate Responsibility and Heath, Safety & Well-being Report.
Inclusion and Diversity are core to our culture and values. Wherever we work, we commit to a culture of mutual respect and belonging by building a truly inclusive workplace rich in diverse people, talents and ideas. jobs.title: School meal worker (Hot Drop) - Delanys GAA
jobs.desc:
A Little Bit About Us
Looking for a job that actually makes a difference - and fits into your day-to-day routine?
At The Lunch Bag, we deliver healthy, hot school meals to children across Ireland. We're the country’s leading school meal provider, and we’re on a mission to help children build healthy habits for life.
We’re changing children’s lives, one lunch at a time. Are you flexible, bubbly, and keen to bring a little extra joy to the school day? We’re looking for people who want to help us keep driving forward and doing something great. Bonus? You’re off when the schools are!
So, what’s the job?
We’re on the hunt for School Lunch Operatives – reliable, cheerful people who take pride in doing things right and bring a bit of warmth to every school day.
Think of yourself as the final link in the lunch chain. All meals are prepared in our headquarters in Nenagh, Tipperary, and then delivered to the Hot Drop Locations. It’s from there that you’ll take over. Your duties will consist of heating the meals in the oven, loading them into vans and driving them to the schools.
If you’re a detail addict and thought this was a little vague, here’s a list for you:
Load pre-packaged school meals into ovens.
Turn on oven and heat meals to specific temperature according to HACCP guidelines.
Unload ovens and load into vans.
Drive the lunches in a company vehicle to the local schools.
Ensure adequate stock levels.
Follow and maintain work and cleaning schedule.
Maintain temperature and cleaning records.
HACCP and Manual Handling Training will be provided.
What we’re looking for
Since you’ll be representing The Lunch Bag in schools, we’re looking for doers - people who are sound, good-natured, and genuinely care about doing a good job. Our values matter to us, and to keep improving the lives of children across the country, we need people who share that same goal.
We’re not asking for bodybuilders, but you do need to be able to lift 14kg boxes as part of the job. You may also need to climb some stairs – not every facility in Ireland has a lift
Working for children is really rewarding – their cute little faces can brighten your day... just don’t let them get hungry or they’ll turn into tiny monsters! So we’re looking for someone who can work quickly, stay calm under pressure, and still do things properly.
All you need is the ability to read English, have full clean Irish driving license, and heat each lunch with care.
We’re looking for cheerful people who like being out and about. Teleportation would make life easier, but until that arrives, we need drivers who are happy to take a roughly one-hour trip to deliver meals to local schools.
I still have questions actually…
No problem! We’re here to answer them.
When will I work?
This job is offered on a part-time basis, 5 hours a day, Monday through Friday! Typical hours of work are 08:30 to 13:30 with flexibility required as start and finish times may be a little earlier or later.
Will I have to work all year long?
No! As schools close for the summer, we follow the academic calendar. As a result, you will work with us approx 183 days of the year and will have the rest off to enjoy some well-deserved rest! Our staff sign on to Social Welfare as Educational Sector Workers during the summer months.
What benefits do I get by joining The Lunch Bag?
Well, for starters - a genuinely supportive team who’ve got your back.
The role’s flexible, ideal if you’re looking to ease back into work or just want something steady during school terms.
How much is it paid?
It’s THE question everybody is asking! The same way we take care of the children in the schools, we take care of our people. You will earn €14.65 per hour – 50c above minimum wage.

Responsibilities
We are currently recruiting for an Electrician on a 2-year Fixed Term Contract. Reporting to the Electrical Foreman, the ideal candidate will be highly motivated self- starter, dependable and can manage multiple tasks simultaneously. The candidate will have excellent attention to detail and have good communication skills. This position requires flexibility to work weekend shift.
Carry out electrical maintenance, fault-finding, root cause analysis and repairs on machinery and plant to required standard.
Perform planned preventative maintenance (PPM) to reduce downtime and improve reliability.
Carry out inspections, testing, and safety checks in line with regulations.
Support installation, commissioning, upgrades, and modification projects where required.
Work on AC/DC motors, control circuits, sensors, drives, PLC systems, and LV/HV installations.
Cable sizing, installation, glanding, and terminations.
Maintain accurate maintenance records and reports (manual and computer systems), while maintaining departmental KPIs.
Support continuous improvement and assist in training apprentices.
Liaise with operators, supervisors, and colleagues to complete work effectively.
Work independently while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and housekeeping
Qualifications, Requirements & Experience
Qualified electrician with industrial maintenance experience.
Strong fault-finding ability on automated equipment advantageous.
Able to read and interpret electrical schematics and machine documentation to support fault-finding, self-directed learning, and development of machine knowledge and maintenance competency.
Competent with Outlook, Excel, SharePoint, and CAFM systems.
Experience in testing, inspection, and compliance.
PLC/CNC/robotics advantageous.
Strong safety awareness, experience working at heights and in confined spaces.
Must be available to work weekends 06:30am – 18:30pm Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

jobs.title: Graduate Piping Engineer
jobs.desc:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
Your impact
Join the Jacobs Graduate Development Program (GDP) and help shape better environments, communities and societies. Bring your passion, creativity and ambition — and together, we’ll create lasting change.
What You’ll Get
Our two‑year Graduate Development Program is designed to accelerate your growth as you begin your Jacobs career. Through blended learning, mentoring, progress reviews and networking, you’ll build capability across four key areas human skills, consulting skills, championing our strategy, and developing your personal passions.
You’ll tailor your learning journey to your interests, career goals and technical strengths — creating a graduate experience that’s uniquely yours. Much of your development will come through real project work, supported by your manager and mentor to ensure you gain the experiences that matter most.
The Graduate Development Program isn’t just a steppingstone — it’s a launchpad. You’ll gain the tools, exposure and support to unlock your potential, working on meaningful projects and collaborating with industry leaders to deliver solutions to complex challenges.
About The Opportunity
We’re proud to hold longstanding partnerships with the world’s leading Life Sciences firms. From designing a facility to manufacture transformative therapies, to accelerating the delivery of life-saving products, we help our clients solve their most important challenges.
Our aim is to give the best minds of today the platform to create the cures of tomorrow. As our clients work to meet aggressive timelines, we strive to be the catalyst for innovation. We provide end-to-end project delivery from a trusted partner in a fast, smart and safe way – on time and within budget.
With more than half a century’s relevant experience to draw upon, this adds up to a total one-stop facility service for our clients.
At Jacobs we provide the resources to turn great ideas into reality, and we’re looking for the most talented and passionate individuals out there to be our next generation of leaders.
The start date for this position is September 2027.
Here's what you'll need
Be working towards a relevant Degree or Master’s level qualification in Mechanical Engineering
A flexible, proactive mindset and motivation to drive your career forward
Adaptability and enthusiasm for learning
Permanent right to work in Ireland
Selection Process
Apply Online
Solo Video Assessment
Interview
Apply before 12 October 2026 to be considered in the first assessment window. Applications may still be accepted afterwards, but roles may be filled during the initial window.
For further information, please see our brochure - https//jacobs-global.foleon.com/brochures/early-careers/
#EarlyCareersUK #GraduateUK #GraduateJob2027 #GraduateCareersUK #GraduaterecruitmentUK #GraduateJobsUK #GraduateopportunitiesUK
Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees.
With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs.
We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here.

jobs.title: Graduate Civil Engineer - Energy Infrastructure
jobs.desc:
See it differently
You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.
Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. The Opportunity
At Arup, our Energy Infrastructure team is shaping the systems that deliver secure, reliable and low-carbon energy. As a Graduate Civil Engineer, you'll contribute to the design of critical infrastructure projects, working alongside experts across multiple disciplines to develop innovative solutions that support the energy transition.
Working With Experienced Engineers, You'll
Support the design and delivery of energy infrastructure projects, including sites, stations, pipelines, cables and associated facilities
Assist with feasibility studies, optioneering and site development
Contribute to civil engineering calculations, technical reports, specifications and drawings
Help design earthworks, drainage, access roads, foundations and underground services
Collaborate with Civil, Structural, Geotechnical, Mechanical, Electrical, Environmental and Digital specialists to develop integrated solutions

An undergraduate or bachelor's degree (or equivalent)
Civil Engineering

A strong interest in civil engineering design and energy infrastructure projects
Knowledge of areas such as site development, drainage, roads, foundations, pipelines, utilities, electrical transmission and distribution, hydrogen, biomethane, renewable energy or offshore wind

Effective written and verbal communication skills

Full working rights in the country of application

Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key.
Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo.
Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working.
Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way.
Closing Date:
12 November 2026
Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in Ireland without our sponsorship.
What we offer you
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

Different people, shared values
Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence.
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas.
We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. Candidates may inform us of any disability, learning difference, or other circumstance that may require reasonable adjustments for interviews or assessments. Any information provided will be used only to make appropriate arrangements and will not be considered in any other aspect of your application or selection process.

jobs.title: Lead DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.desc:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.
What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.
What You'll Do
Lead enterprise application security and DevSecOps initiatives across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
Design and implement scalable security controls embedded within CI/CD pipelines and developer platforms.
Drive adoption and operationalization of security tools including GitHub Advanced Security, OWASP ZAP, Veracode, and SonarQube.
Lead software supply chain security programs using tools such as JFrog Xray/Curation, Black Duck, Sonatype, and FOSSA.
Develop automation and security integrations using Python, Bash, JavaScript, or similar scripting languages.
Partner with engineering and platform teams to establish secure-by-design practices for applications, APIs, containers, and cloud workloads.
Provide technical leadership during security incidents, vulnerability management efforts, and remediation activities.
Mentor engineers and influence enterprise security architecture, standards, and roadmaps.
Develop and maintain security standards and controls for Kubernetes, containers, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud-native application platforms.
Build and operationalize security automation, policy-as-code, and self-service security capabilities that improve developer experience while reducing organizational risk.
Basic Requirements
10+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity engineering, application security, DevSecOps, cloud security, or related security engineering disciplines.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
Experience implementing and operating enterprise-scale security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, SonarQube, and/or OWASP ZAP.
Experience with software supply chain security and open-source risk management tools such as JFrog Xray/Curation, Black Duck, Sonatype, or FOSSA.
Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, JavaScript, or similar languages.
Experience designing and securing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or comparable platforms.
Hands-on experience securing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP).
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience managing enterprise source code management platforms such as Github or Gitlab, developer ecosystems, and software delivery infrastructure.
Preferred Skills/Experience
Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field.
Experience implementing policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code security, and automated security guardrails.
Experience with threat modeling, secure code reviews, and application security testing methodologies.
Knowledge of zero-trust architectures, identity security, cryptography, and cloud-native security controls.
Experience building security metrics, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or GIAC certifications.
Experience leading large-scale security transformation initiatives in highly regulated environments.
Experience mentoring engineers and serving as a technical leader across multiple teams.
Experience securing and managing Kubernetes platforms, container registries, and cloud-native application environments.
Experience implementing software supply chain security controls including artifact signing, SBOM management, provenance, dependency governance, and secure build practices.

jobs.title: Customer Service Incident Coordinator (Croatian Speaking)
jobs.desc:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
Team Overview
Sontiq is TransUnion's identity protection and cyber safety business, helping consumers affected by identity theft, fraud, and data breaches protect and restore their identities through expert support and guidance. The team works closely with customers, clients, and internal specialists to deliver timely assistance during challenging situations, making a meaningful difference in customers' recovery journeys. This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in identity protection and customer support while working in a collaborative, customer-focused environment.
This role reports to the Associate Lead, Customer Support Operations. This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.
Role Overview And Core Responsibilities
As a Customer Service Incident Coordinator (Croatian Speaking), you will support customers impacted by identity theft, fraud, and data breach incidents, helping them navigate the resolution process and access the support they need. You will play an important role in delivering positive customer outcomes, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and providing reassurance and guidance during sensitive situations.
This is a shift pattern role, for the following shift:
Monday to Friday 10:30 - 19:00.
Day To Day You’ll Be
Conduct customer interviews by telephone to gather information relating to fraud, data breach, and identity theft incidents.
Review and analyse case information to assess the nature and severity of incidents and determine appropriate next steps.
Provide professional, empathetic, and high-quality customer support to individuals affected by fraud, identity theft, or data breach events.
Manage customer expectations by providing clear updates and guidance throughout the incident resolution process.
Act as a key point of contact between customers, clients, and internal subject matter experts.
Gather, document, and maintain relevant information and supporting evidence to assist with identity restoration and remediation activities.
Prepare correspondence and communicate with creditors, government agencies, and other third parties when required to support case resolution.
Clearly explain available services, support options, and recommended actions to customers.
Support clients and customers in understanding breach-related incidents and identifying appropriate remediation requirements.
Escalate cases requiring specialist support and coordinate communications, meetings, and updates across relevant teams.
Required Knowledge And Experiences
Fluency in Croatian and English, both written and verbal, to support effective communication with customers, clients, and stakeholders.
Previous customer service experience, ideally within a fast-paced, customer-facing, or support environment.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and provide clear guidance during sensitive customer situations.
Ability to review information, assess customer needs, and make informed decisions when managing incident-related cases.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple cases and maintain accurate records.
Required Technical Skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
Ability to accurately document, maintain, and manage customer case information within internal systems.
Experience using customer service, case management, or customer relationship management platforms.

Be formally registered on the SOLAS Electrical Apprenticeship program

Job Description
We are Omnissa!
The world is evolving fast, and organizations everywhere—from corporations to schools—are under immense pressure to provide flexible, work-from-anywhere solutions. They need IT infrastructure that empowers employees and customers to access applications from any device, on any cloud, all while maintaining top-tier security. That’s where Omnissa comes in.

Built on the vision of autonomous workspaces - self configuring, self-healing, and self-securing - Omnissa continuously adapts to the way people work; delivering personalized and engaging employee experiences, while optimizing security, IT operations and costs. we're experiencing rapid growth—and this is just the beginning of our journey!
At Omnissa, we’re driven by a shared mission to maximize value for our customers. Our five Core Values guide us:
Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency,
and
Maximize Customer Value
—all with the aim of achieving shared success for our clients and our team.
As a global private company with over 4,000 employees, we’re always looking for passionate, talented individuals to join us. If you're ready to make an impact and help shape the future of work, we’d love to hear from you!
What is the opportunity?:
As an
Accounting Manager
, focusing on
Accruals & Expense Analysis
, you'll be a key player in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger. You'll blend your expertise in technical accounting with a sharp eye for process optimization, directly impacting our financial reporting and compliance. This role involves collaborating with other Finance teams and continuously working on process improvements to the accounting close.
Partner with FP&A to understand quarterly business activities and obtain understanding of expense activity, including open POs
Prepare manual journal entries for all PO accruals at period end and quarter end. This will involve reviewing all open POs, understanding GL activity on those POs to date, identifying potential accrual amounts and reviewing those amounts with the FP&A team.
All manual processes will need to be documented in detail.
Be the SME for expense accounts in key areas, including, but not limited to, Cost of Sales, Contractors, and Marketing. This will involve understanding and documenting the types of activities through those accounts, detailed analysis by account by PO, documenting and correcting any reclasses/errors, and ensuring full tie back to support files each period.
Review the prepayments journal for completeness and accuracy. Ensure all activity is reviewed for potential accruals at period end.
Support the preparation and review of related balance sheet reconciliations.
Prepare expense analysis files, performance in-depth analysis and present to Corporate Controller.
Champion process improvements within the general ledger function particularly in relation to PO accruals. This would potentially include reviewing and updating existing manual processes, and leveraging new technologies and automation to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and productivity.
Execute timely and accurate month-end close activities.
Support external audit requests (both at consolidated level and Statutory accounts level) related to expense accounts and associated balance sheet accounts.
Work with FP&A to support the review of Purchase Orders to ensure correct GL mapping.
Supporting of other accounting projects and processes that impact expenses, including software capitalization.
Drive projects, such as: working with FP&A on the set up POs to ensure correct cost centre and account mapping; opportunities for process improvements; setting up and documenting processes and controls around the accruals.
Drive automation and process improvements across all manual account tasks using AI tools.
What will you bring to Omnissa?
An active ACA or CPA designation and industry accounting experience preferred.
Relevant experience with a background from a Big 4 accounting firm (consulting) or General ledger background within SaaS based multinational companies preferred.
Relevant experience in financial analysis and an analytical mind-set.
Specific experience in calculating and managing accruals an advantage.
Strong technical accounting knowledge.
Strong organizational skills and detail-oriented self-starter with the ability to work independently to meet deadlines.
Ability to work within a team to expedite completion of projects with other teams including FP&A and Information Systems.
Experience with MS Office software including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Experience with Oracle and other ERP is preferred.
Experience with Claude or other similar AI tools, specifically around building agents.
Location:
Cork, Ireland
Location Type:
HYBRID
Travel Expectations:
Per Business need

What is the structure and culture of the team like?
We have a global accounting team, responsible for all aspects of Omnissa’s financial statements and more. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to join Omnissa in its early phase of establishing & defining processes. The accounting team is highly motivated and driven by the challenge of standing up accounting systems, processes, and policies for Omnissa, in order to deliver timely and accurate financial statements. We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of public sector IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. About The Role
The Marketing Intern will report to the Senior Marketing Manager, EMEA and will be responsible for supporting the EMEA Growth Marketing team on daily tasks and projects. This is a paid, 3-month internship designed to offer real-world professional experience in marketing and demand generation.
Please note that we do not offer school credit for this internship.
Responsibilities
Assist the EMEA team execute and manage marketing/demand generation activities, including field events, email campaigns, display ads, webinars, social media initiatives and content development that drive new business.
Help with setting up digital marketing campaigns in LinkedIn, XING, Reddit, Demandbase, HubSpot.

Current enrollment in or recent completion of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (Undergraduate or Postgraduate degree) in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field preferred.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy and quality in all deliverables.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and take initiative on assigned tasks.
Basic working knowledge of Google (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive) and Microsoft Office products.

Previous marketing internship or relevant work experience.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer, Employee Engagement Engineering
jobs.desc:
Summary
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
Employee Experience and Productivity (EEP) is part of IS&T and delivers some of the most widely used communication and productivity technology and services across Apple — from tools that enable collaboration to the support teams that keep Apple's workforce running. EEP also leads user experience design and research, and manages the systems behind Apple's original content studios. Within this team is Employee Engagement & Engineering, a small, global team that quickly delivers with long-term vision, building durable, reliable systems meant to last. Our focus is on crafting high-quality, user-centred experiences — delivering AI and system interoperability to make every interaction intuitive, seamless, and genuinely useful for the people who rely on our tools.
Description
As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor to web applications powered by Python, Java, and Rust backends, with frontends spanning React, Vue, and server-rendered templates, guiding technical direction across the stack. You take ownership of complex, ambiguous problems across the frontend, API, and data layers — including internal Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that power AI and system interoperability — and you drive technical decisions that shape how these pieces work together.
You operate with significant autonomy on complex work, applying best practices and critical judgment with minimal guidance. You identify opportunities to improve reliability, developer experience, and user-facing quality, and you extend your impact across related teams and cross-organization initiatives. The team's size means your technical decisions have direct, outsized impact on the applications thousands of Apple employees use every day.
Responsibilities
Guide the technical direction and implementation of complex features spanning microservices architecture (Python, Java, Rust) and frontend interfaces (React, Vue, or server-rendered templates).
Design scalable APIs, data models, and service architectures — including internal MCP servers that expose tools and data to AI systems
Drive features through their full lifecycle: from concept and design through deployment and operational excellence
Apply and help raise engineering best practices across the full stack — frontend architecture, API design, testing strategies, and performance
Identify technical risks and dependencies early; develop mitigation strategies and drive resolution
Mentor and share knowledge with colleagues across both frontend and backend disciplines
Contribute to cross-organization initiatives, expanding your impact beyond the immediate team
Partner with product managers and stakeholders to inform roadmap priorities and technical direction
Lead post-incident reviews and drive improvements in reliability and operational quality
Evaluate and integrate AI services and capabilities — such as MCP-based tooling — to enhance the user experience
Contribute to hiring: interview candidates, calibrate the technical bar across the stack
Minimum Qualifications
Proficiency in Python/Java for backend microservice development, with strong API design skills
Frontend experience with Typescript and a modern framework (React or Vue) and/or server-rendered templates
Solid knowledge of database design — relational and non-relational
Solid knowledge of containerization technologies and K8s
Preferred Qualifications
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
Experience building highly scalable services using Rust.
Experience building and operating production web applications at scale
Experience building MCP servers or other AI tooling and service integration
Understanding of RAG architectures
Experience with observability, monitoring, and site reliability practices
Track record of driving engineering quality improvements across a team
Experience working within enterprise or internal platform environments
Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across time zones
At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

jobs.desc:
Abbott in Ireland
Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,500 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
About Abbott
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
Abbott Ireland Vascular Division Clonmel
Abbott Vascular is one of the world's leading vascular care businesses. Abbott Vascular is uniquely focused on advancing the treatment of vascular disease and improving patient care by combining the latest medical device innovations with world-class pharmaceuticals, investing in research and development and advancing medicine through training and education.
Our broad line of vascular devices–which includes vessel closure, endovascular and coronary technologies–are used to treat vessel diseases of the heart, carotid arteries and peripheral blood vessels. These vessel diseases can lead to heart attack, stroke, critical limb ischemia and other serious vascular conditions.
Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical
practitioner designated by the Company
Purpose Statement
Assists Operations Manager in overseeing and managing the operations and personnel of one or more production areas to maximise productivity and operating efficiencies.
Oversees the coordination of labor, materials, equipment, and tooling to assemble product effectively.
Maintains a high level of product quality and traceability during product assembly.
Ensures production is performed according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Department Operating Procedures (DOPs), Manufacturing Process Instructions (MPI), Just In Time Manufacturing (JIT), and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
Key Responsibilities
Implements a staffing plan by identifying resource requirements, writing justifications for additional personnel, obtaining approval for changes, and coordinating the selection process with Human Resources.
Develops direct reports by securing appropriate training, assigning progressively challenging tasks, applying progressive disciplinary action as appropriate and conducting formal written and verbal performance reviews.
Monitors daily work operations and provides direction and guidance to lower-level supervisors, experienced exempt employees, or skilled nonexempt staff to achieve unit or project goals.
Interacts with internal and external customers, by meeting regularly, responding to requests and explaining procedures.
Interprets and executes policies that affect work processes and personnel within the assigned organisational unit.
Contributes to the development of operational policies and procedures that affect personnel within the assigned organisational unit.
Monitors compliance with company policies and procedures, for example, compliance with Food and Drug Administration (FDA), British Standards Institution (BSI), Equal Employment Opportunities regulations, etc.
Monitors internal and external indicators by reviewing reports and newsletters, reading organisational literature, meeting with peers and reading departmental reports.
Contributes to the development and monitoring of area budget through regular analysis of cost and spending.
Education & Job Skills
National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) level 7 qualification in a relevant discipline and 6+ years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
Monitors progress of exempt individuals, teams, supervisors or nonexempt technical individuals toward departmental goals; monitors costs of projects and of human and material resources within a department or unit; monitors external environment in area of technical or professional responsibility. Will perform this job in a quality system environment. Failure to adequately perform tasks can result in non-compliance with governmental regulations.
Develops and/or identifies new work processes and the improved utilisation of human and material resources within the assigned area or related departments; facilitates others’ involvement in the continuous improvement programme; investigates and solves problems that impact work processes and personnel within the assigned unit.
Promotes the attainment of group goals by selecting, motivating, and training capable staff. Provides leadership to assigned units by communicating and providing guidance towards achieving group objectives.
Schedules human and material resources within a group or section in conjunction with near-term plans to ensure their availability; carries out operations within an established budget.
Assignments are expressed in the form of tasks and objectives; generally makes day-to-day decisions within established guidelines regarding work processes or schedules in order to achieve the programme objectives established by senior management; consequences of erroneous decisions would normally result in serious delays to assigned projects or operations with substantial expenditure of time, human resources, and funds, without jeopardising future business activity.
Works under minimal supervision. Independently determines and develops approach to solutions. Work is reviewed upon completion for adequacy in meeting objectives.

jobs.desc:
Job Description
About the role
Responsible for managing credit risk, collections, and query resolution across a key customer portfolio to support working capital optimisation. Drives process improvement initiatives, automation, and accurate reporting to enable strong team performance against monthly collection targets.
Key Responsibilities
This role operates on a hybrid work policy based at our Shared Service Centre in Cork, Ireland.
Drive cross-functional dispute resolution workflows and root cause analysis with Sales and Customer Service, enforcing strict SLAs to prevent dispute escalation and minimise aged unallocated cash.
Evaluate credit holds and execute autonomous order release decisions within designated delegated authority limits, balancing commercial urgency with credit risk exposure.

Excellent numeracy and analytical capabilities with advanced proficiency in Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs) and/or MS Excel.

General Summary
General Summary:
Qualcomm is leveraging its strengths in compute, connectivity, and AI acceleration to play a central role in the evolution of Cloud AI. The Qualcomm Cloud AI team develops hardware and software platforms enabling efficient inference of large-scale foundation models.
We are seeking a Staff Engineer – AI Model Optimization Architect to lead end-to-end model transformation and optimization for LLMs, VLMs, diffusion, and multimodal models on Qualcomm inference accelerators. This role works closely with compiler, performance, and accuracy teams to translate models into accelerator efficient execution while balancing throughput, latency, memory, and quality. The scope spans Day0 enablement through production deployment, with a strong emphasis on scaling optimizations to future architectures.
Key Responsibilities
Architect and deliver model optimization strategies that transform PyTorch models for efficient inference on Qualcomm accelerators.
Drive graph capture and deployment using PyTorch, ONNX, and torch.compile, including model rewrites and graph-level transformations.
Design and implement fusion kernels using DSL based approaches (e.g., Triton), enabling fused operations and performance critical algorithmic rewrites.
Partner deeply with compiler, performance, and accuracy teams to co-design lowering strategies, kernel fusion, layout decisions, and runtime integration.
Profile and optimize LLM/VLM/diffusion inference for throughput and latency across batch sizes, sequence lengths, and serving modes.
Own transformer specific optimizations including KVcache management, decoding behavior, and long context performance.
Enable and optimize continuous batching (dynamic/iteration-level scheduling), understanding its impact on memory, scheduling, and tail latency.
Architect and scale distributed inference strategies (e.g., sharding and parallelism) across multi-core and multi-device systems.
Establish reusable approaches to scale model optimizations to new hardware architectures, creating robust patterns and tooling.
Debug complex performance or stability issues to root cause and drive production ready solutions.
Required Qualifications
Expert level expertise in PyTorch and inference focused model optimization; strong Python engineering skills.
Hands on experience with torch.compile / TorchDynamo or related graph capture and compilation workflows.
Deep understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, MoEs, and performance trade-offs.
Practical experience with KVcache behavior, serving time optimizations, and memory/performance tradeoffs.
Strong foundation in computer architecture, ML accelerators, and distributed systems.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical efforts and influence design decisions.
MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Experience developing fusion kernels using Triton or similar DSLs, and collaborating with ML compiler teams.
Familiarity with LLM serving stacks and continuous batching systems.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Azure
jobs.desc:
Want to help shape what comes next at a successful, fast-growing software company?
Company Overview
At Poppulo, we help the world’s leading organizations reach every employee, wherever they work.
For a large, distributed workforce, that’s harder than it sounds. Today’s workforce is spread across offices, factories, retail stores, hospitals and other frontline locations. No single communication channel can reach everyone. Poppulo brings those channels together in one AI-powered employee experience platform, helping companies deliver relevant communications wherever their people are located.
More than 10,000 organizations trust us to connect with their workforce across email, mobile, intranet, Microsoft Teams, and digital signage. Our communications reach more than 50 million employees worldwide, and the platform delivers content to more than 600,000 digital signs around the globe. We also help employees engage with their company, celebrate one another’s contributions, and stay connected wherever they work.
We know there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate—we’re all works in progress, picking up new skills as we go. So apply even if you don’t tick every box. We want people who see things differently—because that’s how we see things too.
Key Responsibilities:
DevOps Integration: Collaborate with software development to integrate best practices into the DevOps pipeline, automating controls and promoting a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.
Pipeline Development: Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Gitlab, ensuring efficient, reliable, and repeatable build, test, and deployment processes.
Cloud Infrastructure: Provision and manage cloud infrastructure on Azure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, ensuring environments are scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient.
Continuous Monitoring & Observability: Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system health and rapid incident response.
Security Integration: Embed security practices across the DevOps pipeline, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and adherence to Azure security best practices.
Incident Response: Participate in incident response activities, contributing to root cause analysis and the implementation of preventative measures.
Compliance: Support compliance with industry standards and regulations (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001) through appropriate infrastructure controls, access management, and audit readiness.
Collaboration & Enablement: Provide guidance and support to development teams on DevOps best practices, tooling, and workflows.
Requirements:
5+ years of experience in a DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related role
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience)
Strong hands-on experience with Pipelines, Repositories, Artifacts
Proven experience with Microsoft Azure services, including compute, networking, storage, and identity (AAD/Entra ID)
Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or Bicep/ARM templates
Proficiency in scripting and automation languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash)
Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, AKS)
Solid understanding of observability (e.g MELT) and related tools
Familiarity with Azure security tooling, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Key Vault, and RBAC
Understanding of networking fundamentals in Azure (VNets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, DNS)
Strong communication and collaboration skills across development, operations, and stakeholder teams
Nice to Have:
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., AZ-104)
Experience in repository migrations (including pipelines)
Exposure to security and code quality scanning tools such as SonarQube, or similar
Experience working in regulated industries or with compliance frameworks
Compensation
Annual base salary gross: : 70,000-85,000 EUR plus variable
. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Company's contemplated salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and geographic location. The salary is one component of Company's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards and benefits include variable compensation, short-term incentives, health insurance (several options to choose from), accident and life insurance, access to the best in class learning and development platforms, flexible work arrangement, to name just a few!
Who We Are
We’re a values-driven company. We want people to bring their best selves to work and have a real hand in the products we build and the culture we build together. You’ll be surrounded by smart, warm people who like a challenge, take ownership, and care about doing work that matters. If that sounds like your kind of place, come join us.
We live the Poppulo values each day because they are central to everything we do.
Bring Your Best Self - We show up authentically, remain self-aware, and always strive to improve.
See It. Own It. Solve It - We proactively innovate and solve problems for our customers and one another. We set high standards for our work, build a culture of learning, and acknowledge both our successes and our failures.
Together, We’re Better - We value and celebrate our diversity. We learn from others, respect their expertise, and focus on building trust. That’s what makes us a team.
We’ve been recognized as a Top 10 Great Place to Work company and named one of the Best Workplaces in Tech and Best Workplaces for Women. We’re a fast-growing global technology company with teams in the United States, Ireland, France, the United Kingdom, and India.
Poppulo is an equal opportunity employer.
We are committed to protecting your privacy. For details on how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, please refer to our Job Applicant Privacy Policy. Please also review AI in Our Hiring Process for information on our approach to AI in hiring and guidance for candidates.

Own SLOs, alerting and incident response for the services you ship, and fix underlying causes when things go wrong.
