5+ years building, deploying and running backend services in production.
Strong Python, C#/.NET, Java or a similar backend language.
Experience with
distributed or event-driven systems
, including microservices, idempotency, ordering, retries and failure handling.
Experience evolving APIs and schemas without breaking consumers.
Strong SQL and a working knowledge of how cloud data warehouses execute and cost queries.
Experience with payments, billing, ledgers or other systems where data accuracy and auditability matter would be a plus.
OTHER DETAILS
Hybrid working: 3 days per week in the Cork office.
An AI-first engineering culture, with Claude Code and Cursor part of the daily toolkit.

jobs.title: Graduate Engineer - Service & Repairs Department
jobs.desc:
About the role:
If you are a graduate of mechanical, electrical, civil or automation engineering and you're ready for responsibility and autonomy, while being supported by a team of experienced peers, look no further!
We are
now recruiting
an engineering graduate to join our busy Service and Repairs Division based in Mallow, Co. Cork.
As part of our ever growing team, you will be responsible for the engineering activities on municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, drinking water treatment plants and various pumping stations.
No two days will be the same, so your activities will vary and will be agreed with the Project Co-Ordinator on an ongoing basis. You will support the co-ordinators and wider team through the process up to and including the onsite service and repairs element of our works including managing SLA's.
A highly varied, challenging role providing invaluable exposure to the right candidate.
So fast track your career with us!
Key Responsibilities:
Project management of water & wastewater pumping and treatment installations
Assist in procurement of all items for projects and SLA's including labour, parts and materials
Timeline planning of installations from repairs and maintenance, awarding of contract to completion and handover of all documentation including service level agreements
Assist in management of site labour for projects
Ensuring the project is completed on time
Writing engineering reports, method statements, risk assessments and commissioning schedules
Responsible for O&M, health & safety documentation and assist with enforcement of safe work practices onsite during all EPS installation
Key Competencies and Skills:
Proficiency in PC skills to include MS office and Project software is advantageous
Good inter-personal and communication skills
Strong engineering, analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong collaborative skills with an ability to work effectively in a team environment
Have a willingness to learn and be challenged in the water and wastewater Industry
Interest in implementing opportunities and initiatives in a time restricted schedule
Develop specific goals and plans to prioritise, organise and accomplish stated deadlines
Qualifications:
Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil or Automation Engineering
Strong communication skills and an enthusiasm about working in a highly driven team
Full EU/ Irish driving licence
Compensation Package:
Competitive salary and benefits package
Robust graduate programme
Opportunities for professional development and career growth
CPD accredited employer
A collaborative and supportive work environment
Laptop or desktop and work mobile phone provided
Flexible working options, dependent on location and role requirements
Opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment and develop within the team
See company website for more information on the benefits of working in EPS Group
We welcome speculative applications from individuals of all levels.
Equal Opportunity Statement
- EPS Group is an equal opportunities employer.
Company Profile
Since 1968, we have grown from a modest electrical and pumping services business and developed into an innovative, internationally exporting product and service provider, now focused upon the water, wastewater and clean technology sectors, operating across the Republic of Ireland, the UK and Northern Europe.
We are an international water infrastructure specialist, one of the few genuine end-to-end service providers in the global water sector, providing large scale employment, bringing market leading and ground breaking technologies to Ireland and working to improve the country's water infrastructure.
Our vision is to be the best and most rewarding place to work for our teams, to be our customer's outstanding partner of choice and we are committed to being a Net Zero, sustainable business.

jobs.title: Project Support Administrator
jobs.desc:
Murphy is recruiting for a Project Support Administrator to join our growing Water team supporting the delivery of major infrastructure projects across Ireland under the Uisce Éireann Engineering, Consultancy and Infrastructure (ECI) Framework.
This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and commercially aware administrator who enjoys working in a fast-paced project environment. The successful candidate will provide project coordination, reporting, financial administration and document control support across a portfolio of important water and wastewater projects.
The Project Support Administrator will play a key role in supporting project teams, ensuring project information, reporting and administrative processes are maintained to a high standard throughout the project lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
Project Coordination
Support Project Managers with day-to-day project administration.
Coordinate project meetings, workshops and design reviews.
Issue meeting agendas, record minutes and track actions.
Maintain project trackers, actions logs and registers.
Assist in the preparation of monthly project and performance reports.
Document Control & Information Management
Manage document control systems and Common Data Environments (CDE).
Maintain project correspondence and document registers.
Ensure project documentation complies with Murphy and industry standards.
Support the efficient distribution and storage of project information.
Commercial & Financial Administration
Assist with timesheet collation and labour allocation records.
Maintain project cost trackers and expenditure records.
Support the preparation of payment applications and supporting documentation.
Track purchase orders, invoices and supplier information.
Maintain risk and opportunity registers.
Reporting & Governance
Produce KPI reports and performance dashboards.
Maintain programme and project progress trackers.
Track key framework deliverables and submission deadlines.
Support governance reviews and project approvals.
Assist with the preparation of project business cases and supporting documentation.
Project Controls Support
Update project schedules and progress trackers.
Maintain project change logs.
Track actions arising from design and project reviews.
Monitor key project milestones and deliverables.
Support procurement and supply chain administration activities.
Essential Requirements
Minimum 3 years' administration experience within construction, engineering, utilities or infrastructure sectors.
Strong financial, commercial or business administration experience.
Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
Experience using document management systems.
Strong organisational and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities across a number of projects.
Experience supporting project delivery teams in a fast-paced environment.
Desirable
Experience working on water, wastewater or infrastructure projects.
Knowledge of Uisce Éireann processes and standards.
Experience using:
SharePoint
Power BI
Microsoft Project
Oracle
What You Will Get In Return
27 days holiday, plus bank holidays with the option to buy an additional 2 days holiday each year, holidays increase with length of service
Discretionary annual bonus and annual salary review
Above market rate contributory pension scheme
Life assurance, health screening and enhanced sick pay
Generous Private Healthcare Allowance
Enhanced maternity and paternity pay and a maternity returners bonus
Extra 2 days holiday for all employees getting married and a wedding bonus
Dedicated and continued investment in your professional development
Other Murphy benefits include retail discounts, discounted gym memberships, cycle to work scheme etc
About Murphy
Murphy is formally recognised as a sector leading employer, Platinum Investors In People accredited. At Murphy, we are incredibly proud of our diverse workforce. Not only do our people represent over 60 different nationalities, but they also represent a wide range of backgrounds, ethnicities and ages.
If you are unable to apply via the usual process, please call
Lee Parker on 0872169246
to discuss in more detail.
Murphy is unable to employ anyone who does not have the legal right to live and work in Ireland.

Irish Distillers, a Pernod Ricard company, is a producer of some of the world’s most well-known and successful Irish whiskeys and Ireland’s leading supplier of spirits. Job Purpose
The Laboratory Technician will support the Central Laboratory team by carrying out routine laboratory testing, equipment calibrations, sample preparation, inventory management, and data recording activities. The role contributes to maintaining product quality standards while ensuring compliance with laboratory quality systems, health and safety requirements, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Perform calibrations and routine checks of laboratory equipment in accordance with established procedures.
Conduct wet chemistry analysis on product and quality control samples.
Carry out analytical testing to support quality control and co-packer requirements.
Support the maintenance of chemical inventories, laboratory consumables, and retained sample stocks.
Assist with sample preparation and solution preparation for laboratory testing activities.
Prepare samples for sensory evaluation activities.
Accurately record laboratory results and maintain laboratory documentation.
Enter sample information and analytical results into the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).
Maintain laboratory housekeeping standards and support 5S practices.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory.
Work in accordance with the Central Laboratory Quality Management System and ISO quality standards.
Ensure compliance with all site health, safety, and environmental requirements.
Skills, Experience & Qualifications
Essential
Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Food Science, or a related scientific discipline.
Laboratory experience gained through industry, internships, placements, research projects, or academic studies.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
Good planning, organisational, and time management skills.
Strong numerical and IT skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
Ability to follow laboratory procedures, quality standards, and health and safety requirements.
Desirable
Experience working in a quality control, manufacturing, food, beverage, pharmaceutical, or regulated laboratory environment.
Experience using Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS).
Knowledge of ISO quality standards or laboratory quality management systems.
Familiarity with wet chemistry techniques and laboratory equipment calibration.
Understanding of laboratory housekeeping, 5S principles, and continuous improvement practices.

If you feel your skills and experience are a good match for this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement listed. Location: Midleton, Cork

Irish Distillers, a Pernod Ricard company, is a producer of some of the world’s most well-known and successful Irish whiskeys and Ireland’s leading supplier of spirits. Job Purpose:
If you are a self-motivated individual who is passionate about analytical chemistry and quality assurance, Irish Distillers could be your next employer. We are looking for an experienced Analytical Chemist to join our team at Irish Distillers in Cork. Reporting to the Head of Analytical and Technical Development, the Analytical Chemist will work to ensure the quality of our products by providing ongoing technical support for finished bottle analysis. The successful candidate will also provide analytical support and troubleshooting to manufacturing processes, as well as to other groups within Central Labs and Production Teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Perform testing and analysis of finished bottle products and other spirits samples in a timely and efficient manner according to existing procedures and ISO standards.
Perform calibrations and daily checks of the laboratory equipment.
Maintain up-to-date, complete and precise records of all tests performed.
Develop and update in-house laboratory procedures as appropriate.
Support senior analytical chemists and scientists during analytical method development and validation.
Support any on-going research projects and Pilot Plant activity.
Perform troubleshooting and basic maintenance of laboratory equipment.
Create and update laboratory documentation and procedures.
Perform second person check/review of other colleague’s laboratory data and notebooks.
Log-in samples and enter results into the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS)
Record non-conformances and perform investigations.
Maintain chemical and chemical reagents inventory up to date and ensure appropriate waste disposal
Work according to the Central Lab Quality Management System and ensure compliance to the ISO 9001 quality standards.
Actively participate in Internal audits and safety lab walkthrough.
Ensure a high level of laboratory housekeeping.
Identify and make recommendations for improvements as part of a team within or outside the department in order to ensure continuous improvement.
Communicate results effectively with the team and other teams across Central Laboratory.
Support all other on-going laboratory functions and requirements.
Ensure Midleton site and Central lab Health and Safety requirements are implemented in lab area and followed.
Skills & Knowledge:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemistry or related field
At least 3-5 years of experience in analytical chemistry, preferably in a manufacturing or laboratory environment
Good understanding of the principles of ISO quality systems.
Good analytical knowledge and experience about GC, HPLC and ICP techniques.
Weighing, Pipetting, Solution / standard preparation.
Be able to work on his/her own, as well as with the team.
Well organised, accurate and have strong documentation skills.
Good numeric and IT skills
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Desirable Skills
Practical understanding of both the fundamentals and practical implementation of analytical science with a bias towards Gas and Liquid Chromatography.
Good investigative capability and a good ability to document and communicate results.

Bold & Agile
Decisive and courageous even in the face of difficult & complex situations and always learns from past experiences. Steps up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said in a respectful way
Consumer Centric;
Develops customer/consumer intimacy with a focus on technology to innovate and create more value for the consumer and Pernod Ricard.
Open & Authentic;
Role models who instil trust, engage teams by giving and receiving feedback and constantly fostering open dialogue.
Growth Mindset;
Forward thinking; embodies a vision that translates into inspiring strategies. Thrives in a complex and changing world deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Achieves results while balancing rigorous planning and flexible transversal collaboration. Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives

Tricel, a family-run business, was founded in 1973 by Anne Stack and Con Stack. This year marks the company’s 50th year in business. Among the markets served by the company are storage tanks, pumps, sewage treatment tanks, construction products, and lubricant and composite distribution. With its headquarters in Killarney, the Tricel Group consists of 15 companies across Europe, including seven manufacturing facilities. The company employs more than 600 people at these locations. Secondary - Dublin
THE PERSON:
A successful candidate will work with architects and fellow design and verification leads. Skilled at driving team and tasks from start to completion with superior quality. Drives to learn and perform at his or her highest potential in a technical capacity. Flexible in working hours to accommodate working with co-workers in different time-zones.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Work on PCIe Controller verification execution from test plan to verification signoff.
Collaborate with architects and designers to understand the IP features.
Write/Implement/Review Test Plans.
Verification of critical high speed digital designs using both coverage driven random and directed testing techniques as well as Formal verification.
Own some or all aspects of the Verification flow from initial test planning to coverage convergence and sign-off closure for one or more features and aspects of SubSystem level IP interoperability.
Build testbench components and develop test and sequence libraries, by applying Objected Oriented Programming Verification techniques following UVM methodology.
Conduct and participate in Code Reviews.
Technical leadership, including block ownership from start to finish and verification sign-off.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:
Experience with Low Power verification techniques and UPF flow is highly desirable
PC System Architecture: PCI Express, SATA, USB, Ethernet, HyperTransport, DDR. Excellent knowledge of standard bus/interface protocols (i.e., AXI, AHB, AMBA, OCP, PIPE).
Exposure to AI implementation to improve verification flows
Experience with simulation profiling, efficiency improvements, acceleration, HLS tools/process.
Must be a self-starter, and able to drive independently and efficiently challenge time-critical tasks to on-time completion.
Strong communication, time management, and presentation skills.
Scripting language experience: Perl, Ruby, Makefile, shell preferred.
Proven experience in verifying commercially successful IPs, Subsystems and or SoCs.
Strong ability to provide mentorship and guidance to junior and senior engineers, a very effective team player, must have strong technical skills and provide a positive influence on team morale and culture.
Must be expert in SystemVerilog, UVM.
Proficient in object-oriented programming, scripting (Ruby, Python, Perl), and low-level programming languages.
ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:
Bachelors or Masters degree in Electronics/Computer/Electrical Engineering with 7+ years of relevant DV experience

Collaborate with all groups to improve company processes, systems, and intellectual infrastructure to promote organisational learning and continuous improvement.

Sunbeam Veterinary Hospital | Cork, Ireland
Sunbeam Veterinary Group is seeking an experienced Referral Veterinary Surgeon to join our growing team at our purpose-built referral hospital in Cork. This is a unique opportunity for a surgeon who is passionate about delivering outstanding patient care while developing and expanding their own referral caseload within a busy and well-established hospital environment.
We are ideally looking for a full-time permanent surgeon; however, we are open to discussing flexible or part-time arrangements for the right candidate.
With a preferred start date from November 2026 onwards (flexible), this position offers exceptional clinical freedom, excellent facilities and genuine scope to shape the role around your interests and professional ambitions.
Located just a short distance from Cork city centre, Sunbeam offers an excellent base for enjoying everything the city and wider county have to offer. Cork combines a vibrant food, culture and social scene with easy access to some of Ireland’s most beautiful coastline, beaches and countryside. With Cork Airport nearby and excellent transport links, it’s a fantastic place to expand your career while enjoying a great quality of life outside of work.
About Sunbeam Veterinary Group
Sunbeam Veterinary Group is a 100% small animal veterinary group with practices located across Cork, including Blackpool, Cobh, Passage West and Kinsale Road. Our referral centre, based at Northpoint Business Park on Cork's northside, provides advanced surgical, diagnostic and emergency services to patients throughout the region.
We operate a busy referral hospital with 24/7 emergency and critical care support, providing around-the-clock veterinary cover. Our clinical team consists of approximately nine veterinary surgeons, fifteen qualified veterinary nurses, hydrotherapy specialists and a dedicated support team. We also benefit from multiple certificate holders and experienced clinicians across a range of disciplines, creating a highly collaborative and supportive environment.
Our Facilities Include
CT scanning
Digital radiography and ultrasound
In-house laboratory
Laparoscopic surgery
Endoscopy
Advanced orthopaedic and soft tissue surgery
Hospitalisation and intensive care facilities
Canine hydrotherapy and rehabilitation services
The Opportunity
This role is centred around referral-level surgery and would suit an ambitious surgeon who enjoys managing complex cases while building strong relationships with both clients and referring veterinary practices.
You will take responsibility for a busy and varied surgical caseload involving both soft tissue and orthopaedic procedures, managing cases from initial assessment through to surgery and follow-up care. You will work alongside an experienced multidisciplinary team, with access to advanced imaging, rehabilitation services and emergency support.
We are looking for someone who is confident handling referral cases independently and who is excited by the opportunity to further develop and grow surgical services within the practice. There is significant flexibility within this role, allowing the successful candidate to shape the caseload around their individual interests and expertise.
Experience or a strong interest in laparoscopic and endoscopic procedures would be highly advantageous as we continue to develop these services.
Candidate Requirements
VCI registered or eligible for VCI registration
A recognised Surgical Certificate
Proven experience in both soft tissue and orthopaedic surgery
Comfortable managing referral-level cases independently
Ability to maintain and develop a surgical caseload
Strong communication skills with clients and referring veterinary surgeons
An approachable, collaborative and personable working style
A commitment to contributing positively to a large, experienced clinical team
Working Pattern
A full-time position consists of a four-day week, working 40 hours between Monday and Friday within the hospital opening hours of 8am to 7pm.
The Rota Also Includes
1 in 8 weekends
2 Bank Holiday shifts per year
There are no out-of-hours responsibilities, as these are covered by our dedicated, in-house emergency service.
What We Offer Our Team
In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both personal wellbeing and professional development.

22 days annual leave
Birthday leave
Paid maternity leave
Paid paternity and adoptive leave

5 paid CPD days per year

Career progression opportunities across both clinical and leadership pathways
VCI membership paid
VDS cover paid

Employer pension contributions

jobs.title: Civil Engineer T&D
jobs.desc:
Shape a future with purpose at Arup in Ireland
Support the delivery of civil infrastructure for renewable energy projects and electricity networks.
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world. We have been present in Ireland since 1946 and we have a team of more than 950 engineers, consultants, and qualified technical personnel. We work for clients from the public and private sectors, providing creative and sustainable solutions based on the efficient use of resources.
Our Energy team in Ireland delivers high‑value technical, design and advisory services across a diverse portfolio of energy and infrastructure projects, supporting the development of a resilient and low‑carbon electricity system. Our work spans electricity transmission and distribution infrastructure, renewable energy integration and grid reinforcement, including civil engineering design to support renewable energy infrastructure, including offshore wind and electricity networks, across Ireland and the wider Arup regions.
The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to join our Energy Infrastructure team and contribute to the delivery of electricity Transmission & Distribution (T&D) projects. The role will involve supporting the civil design and delivery of substations, cable routes and associated infrastructure, providing civil engineering design to support renewable energy infrastructure, including offshore & onshore wind, BESS, Solar and electricity networks. Working as part of multi‑disciplinary project teams from early feasibility and route optioneering through to detailed design and delivery. The successful candidate will work within a well‑established and experienced group, benefiting from strong technical support and exposure to a broad range of civil engineering activities associated with T&D and renewable energy projects. This is a permanent position within the Energy team.
As a Civil Infrastructure Engineer At Arup, You Will
Deliver elements of civil infrastructure design for electricity transmission and distribution projects.
Contribute to the development of underground cable routing, corridor studies and alignment design.
Support the civil design of substations, including site layout design, earthworks, drainage, access arrangements, hardstandings and structural interfaces.
Support civil engineering design for renewable energy electrical infrastructure, including grid connections and onshore works associated with offshore wind projects.
Understand the appointed design scope, identify associated deliverables and define the workflow required to complete assigned elements of work.
Work within a multi‑disciplinary design team, coordinating with electrical, mechanical, environmental and planning specialists to deliver integrated design solutions.
Produce civil design outputs including drawings, reports, specifications and design calculations.
Support delivery of assigned work packages to agreed programme, quality and budget targets.
Plan and manage assigned workload, ensuring appropriate quality assurance and coordination within the design team.
Ensure all designs are completed in accordance with relevant standards, specifications, safety requirements and client procedures.
Does this role inspire you?
We are looking for a proactive engineer with a strong interest in civil infrastructure delivery within the electricity and renewable energy sectors.
The Ideal Candidate Will Have
A relevant third‑level Degree (Level 8 or higher) in Civil Engineering (or a related discipline).
Circa 3–5 years’ post‑qualification experience, primarily in civil design, gained within a consultancy or comparable engineering environment.
Membership of a relevant professional body.
Experience in civil infrastructure design, ideally related to electricity transmission and/or distribution, grid connections or comparable linear infrastructure schemes.
Experience working with/interfacing with Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and/or Distribution Network Operators (DNOs), including familiarity with their standards, specifications and approval processes, would be an advantage.
Experience or exposure to underground utilities and cable infrastructure, including trenching, ducting, protection systems and reinstatement.
Experience in site development and layout design, including earthworks, drainage, access roads and hardstandings.
Familiarity with industry software such as Civil 3D, AutoCAD and/or Revit.
Experience working within multi‑disciplinary design teams and coordinated BIM environments.
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
Good communication skills, with the ability to work effectively within a team environment.
How to apply for this vacancy?
To apply for this vacancy, register your updated CV and a cover letter in English.
Why Arup?
At Arup, we offer a rewarding career with a global company committed to a better future. Our unique trust ownership structure allows us to prioritize meaningful work and invest in our people. We also offer a unique profit share program, allowing our members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
Benefits That Work For You
Professional Growth & Development: Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and mentorship to enhance your skills and advance your career at Arup.
Global Opportunities: Collaborate with colleagues worldwide and explore potential short-term or long-term assignments at other Arup offices and project locations.
Financial Well-being & Ownership: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package and share in Arup's success through our global profit-sharing programme.
Work-Life Balance: We offer a hybrid working model and flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance.
Well-being and Culture: Access to a range of well-being programs, including sports subsidies, social activities, and initiatives promoting a healthy work-life balance. We foster a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.
Arup is recognized as one of the best companies to work thanks to our flexibility policies. We also adhere to the Code of Principles of Generational Diversity, committing to equal opportunities regardless of age.
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective where individuality is encouraged. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. You’ll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning - to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of the world around us. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.
We welcome applications from talented individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible. If you need any assistance or adjustments, please visit our Candidate Support page for contact information and assistance. We're happy to help.

jobs.title: Process Analyst
jobs.desc:
About Kerry
Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.
About the role
We are seeking an experienced
Process Analyst
to work as the data and analytics interface for Kerry’s Enzyme Process Technology (PT) Team. Embedded within the wider PT team, over three production sites, the role will focus on curating, structuring, analysing, and visualising process data across the entirety of the microbial enzyme production life cycle.
The successful candidate will partner closely with the PT teams on site to curate, structure and visualise manufacturing and process data from Kerry’s core systems (including SAP, EPM/MES platforms, SCADA systems and local Excel based datasets), turning complex and fragmented data streams into clear insights that support yield, recovery, productivity, process robustness and facilitate operational excellence.
Key responsibilities
Data Curation & Integration
Extract, clean and harmonise process and manufacturing data from
SAP (process orders, batch data, confirmations, material movements, yields)
EPM / MES / LIMS / SCADA systems
Site level Excel trackers and historical datasets
Resolve inconsistencies between system data and off-line data repositories
Improve transparency and traceability of process performance data
Understand how SAP master data structures influence process orders, confirmations, yields, and performance reporting
Process & Manufacturing Analytics
Analyse and trend process performance data across the end-to-end enzyme production process, including Inoculum preparation and cultivation; Fermentation metrics and profiles; and Downstream operational parameters and yields
Support PT with robust analysis of key performance indices including yield and rolled throughput yield; recovery of unit operations; Enzyme titre and productivity; Losses, variability and deviation impacts
Provide analytical support to process optimisation initiatives and continuous improvement projects
Work with PAT and IoT-enabled sensors, historians, and data acquisition systems to contextualise high-frequency process data alongside batch and transactional datasets
Data Architecture
Design and implement practical data frameworks and architecture to improve data accessibility and data reliability
Reduce manual data handling by improving integration between SAP and reporting tools, while standardising data flows and calculation logic
Work with each respective production site to align on data architecture and tools
Clearly document datasets, assumptions and calculations used in PT reporting

jobs.title: Technical AEO Manager
jobs.desc:
The Role
As Technical AEO Manager, you own Aiven's visibility in AI answer engines. Developers and engineering leaders now find, compare and choose infrastructure through ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and AI Overviews more than through a results page. Your job is to make Aiven the answer they get, and to prove what that visibility delivers in signups, pipeline and revenue.
You know how LLMs retrieve, evaluate and cite content, and you build the measurement and content standards that win those citations. Your technical SEO background gives you the tools to diagnose and fix what stands in the way, but the goal you manage against is citations and recommendations, not rankings. You turn what you learn into action across marketing, product and sales.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role in our Revenue Marketing team, working daily with Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Docs and Web Engineering. You'll serve two audiences with different needs: developers and builders who want deep, accurate technical content, and engineering decision makers who want to understand why Aiven for cost, reliability and scale.
Key Responsibilities
AI visibility measurement: Own how Aiven measures its presence in AI answers. Run Peec and Ahrefs for competitive visibility and citation tracking, maintain a curated set of high-intent prompts across both audiences, and build the custom analysis on top that platforms don't offer, such as product-alignment scoring, intent gap detection and task-completion checks.
Commercial impact and reporting: Connect AI and organic visibility to product signups, trial activation, demo requests and sales-ready leads using Omni and Salesforce. Deliver a clear weekly report to marketing and sales leadership on what moved, why, and what we're doing about it, with attribution caveats stated plainly.
Content structure and retrieval quality: Set the standard for how our blog, docs and product pages are structured to be retrieved and cited by LLMs: self-contained sections, consistent structured data and entity markup, aligned dates and authorship. Audit and prune existing content, identify gaps by prompt intent, and work with Product Marketing and DevRel to fill them.
Technical SEO: Own the technical roadmap for aiven.io: crawlability, indexing, rendering, schema and site architecture. Find the issues, write tickets Web Engineering can act on.
Agent journey insight: Identify where AI agents fail between recommending Aiven and completing a task through our docs, MCP server, CLI, Terraform provider or API. Quantify the impact and bring a prioritised case to Product.
Third-party presence: Identify the external sources that drive citations in our categories (community forums, partner docs, review sites, independent tutorials) and work with DevRel, Partner Marketing and Communications to grow Aiven's footprint on them.
Experimentation: Track changes in models, crawlers and AI search features. Run structured tests on content format, markup and delivery, document the results and roll out what works.
Ideal Candidate
Proven AEO results: You have improved a B2B technology brand's visibility and citations in AI answer engines and can show the before, the after and what you did. We care about demonstrated results, not years with the label.
Strong technical SEO foundation: Site crawls, JavaScript rendering, structured data and Schema.org, crawler and log analysis, and working with developers through well-written tickets and QA.
You build your own analysis: Comfortable in Python and with LLM APIs. You've used embeddings, similarity scoring or automated audits to answer questions your tools couldn't, such as which content is actually aligned to product or where intent coverage is missing.
Understand how LLMs retrieve and cite: Practical knowledge of chunking, RAG, entity signals, freshness and trust, and which content formats have stopped earning citations.
Commercially fluent: Experience connecting organic performance to pipeline in a CRM and BI stack, and comfortable presenting to sales and marketing leaders. You can hold a line between what is proven and what is correlated.
Clear communicator and collaborator: You share progress openly, build buy-in across product, engineering and marketing, and make it easy for others to act on your findings.
Adaptable: The landscape shifts monthly. You experiment, learn and adjust without waiting for a playbook.
Bonus: Experience in cloud, data or infrastructure companies; familiarity with Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch or ClickHouse; contributions to open source, developer tooling or technical documentation; experience directing agency partners.
Amazing! What’s next:
If you think Aiven is the place for you and that our Values align with yours, send us your resume and we’ll get in touch!
Global Benefits:
Our global benefits are designed to help you thrive and grow, personally and professionally:
Participate in Aiven’s equity plan.
Balance work and life with our hybrid work policy.
Choose the equipment you need to set yourself up for success.
Use your Professional Development Plan budget for learning opportunities.
Receive holistic wellbeing support through our global Employee Assistance Program.
Inquire about our Global Time Off Commitment (Parental and Sick Leave, as well as Personal Time)
Enjoy country-specific benefits for our global cast.
How to Recognize and Avoid Employment Scams:
There has been a rise in fake job postings used by scammers to get personal information. At Aiven, all of our emails relating to recruitment come from an @aiven.io, @greenhouse.io or @eu.greenhouse.io domain and all of our interviews are conducted by video call or in person. Our interviews will never occur via text or chat. If you’re unsure of the legitimacy of a job opportunity/offer pertaining to Aiven, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at recruitment@aiven.io.

Through its interconnected pillars—Lilly Ventures, Lilly Gateway Labs, Lilly ExploR&D, and Lilly TuneLab—Catalyze360 strategically removes barriers that traditionally block bold science from becoming life-changing medicines, providing biotechs with flexible combinations of capital, physical lab space, R&D capabilities, AI/ML tools, and decades of enterprise learning.
Lilly ExploR&D is a team of drug discovery and development experts who partner with biotechs from discovery through clinical proof-of-concept, putting Lilly's industry-leading capabilities behind their missions. We provide flexible support—from strategic consulting to full program execution—making it faster, easier, and more capital-efficient for innovators to transform bold science into life-changing medicines.
Job Summary
The Senior Director will lead the regulatory and medical writing function within ExploR&D, overseeing the preparation and delivery of clinical and regulatory documents and development of IT tools to support the document writing needs of ExploR&D and our partners. The Senior Director will be responsible for business process management, vendor management, systems management, systems implementation, and emerging technology implementation. The Senior Director will provide strategic, tactical, and technical/operational direction, and lead writing deliverables and strategies across the ExploR&D portfolio.
The Senior Director collaborates with cross-functional, multidisciplinary teams, including internal and external stakeholders, to produce high-quality regulatory and scientific documents intended to support regulatory interactions, clinical trial execution, and external partner’s strategies.
The Senior Director is responsible for coordinating content across complex documents, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and clarity. These documents may include preclinical, clinical and regulatory documents (such as protocols, investigator’s brochures, clinical study reports, briefing documents, regulatory responses, Target Product Profiles, regulatory strategy documents, and Integrated Development Plans), global clinical trial applications (IND/CTA documents), and external scientific publications (such as abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and presentations).
Key Responsibilities
Document Preparation and Management
Lead cross-functional teams to ensure timely development of writing deliverables
Manage and track workload; escalate resource capacity issues as needed
Plan, write, edit, review, and strategically coordinate complex regulatory documents, development strategies, and scientific publications
Oversee and coordinate quality review and finalization of documents
Provide expertise on databases and other tools necessary to perform work (such as document management systems)
Consultancy on Behalf of ExploR&D
Represent ExploR&D in assigned projects, interacting directly with biotech partners
Strategically build and manage relationships with biotech partners and vendors
Serve as an expert for ExploR&D portfolio and associated asset development, as it pertains to medical writing activities and related expertise
Contribute to the identification, prioritization, and assessment of collaboration opportunities
Maintain and enhance knowledge of regulatory and publication guidelines
Network with Lilly functions to share best practices
Capability Building and Strategic Leadership
Build a suite of AI writing capabilities to increase efficiency within ExploR&D, working with internal experts and external vendors
Identify, evaluate, develop, and implement systems and tools that increase efficiency and streamline document development, such as AI Authoring tools, automation tools and document management systems
Allocate medical writing resources to support incoming projects
Support ExploR&D’s strategic direction by implementing document standards, workflows, and priorities in support of the portfolio
Identify and implement improvements in writing processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and templates to ensure they are fit for purpose
People Development
Provide informal coaching to others by sharing technical information, giving guidance, and answering questions
Support cross-functional coaching, mentoring, and training
Train, coach, and mentor staff to deepen their medical writing expertise, improve communication skills, and build strong relationships across ExploR&D functions and with external partners (this may be through direct or indirect reporting relationships, as assigned)
If assigned, recruit, develop, and retain an operationally capable workforce skilled in medical writing and its application in clinical development
Champion a commitment to quality and safety
Support a culture that fosters inclusion, innovation, and judgement-based decision making
Education
Minimum Requirements
Advanced graduate degree (PharmD, PhD, MD) in a health-related or scientific field
Experience
At least 7 years’ of experience in the pharmaceutical industry in two or more of the following areas: preclinical development (PK/PD, pharmacology, toxicology), clinical development, CMC, regulatory affairs, regulatory writing.
Demonstrated mastery of written English with at least 3 years’ experience in writing regulatory, clinical trial documents, and/or scientific publications.
Additional Skills And Preferences
Experience in clinical trial process and/or regulatory activities.
Deep understanding of investigational product requirements, especially GCP and GLP regulations.
Demonstrated leadership in managing document development for various document types/indications.
Experience in managing external partnerships/vendor relationships.

The Role:
The Support Worker will play a vital role in empowering individuals by planning and setting meaningful goals that address their unique personal, social, recreational, academic, independent living, community integration, training, and supported employment needs.
They will actively guide and support individuals to realise their aspirations, helping them reach identified priorities and achieve greater independence and self sufficiency. The Support Worker operates within a person centred framework, prioritising each individual’s choices and needs. Familiarity with basic IT skills for reporting, record keeping, and communication.

Competitive Salary from €42,000
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.

nd
Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*

Bike to Work
Long Service Awards

About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move.  Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”.  Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers.  It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 170 stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/

tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie

At GMIB, part of Gallagher, we're not looking for insurance experts. We're looking for great people.
People who enjoy helping others. People who are curious, motivated and eager to learn. People who want to build a career where they can develop new skills, gain professional qualifications and make a real difference to customers every day.
As part of Gallagher, one of the world's leading insurance brokerages, we're proud to invest in our people. Whether you're starting your career, looking for a fresh challenge, or bringing experience from retail, hospitality, banking, customer service or another industry, we'll give you the training, support and opportunities you need to succeed.
You don't need previous insurance experience.
We'll teach you everything you need to know about the industry, provide support towards professional qualifications, and help you build a rewarding long-term career with us.
How You'll Make An Impact
As a Customer Service Executive, you'll help customers find the protection that's right for them while delivering a friendly, professional and personalised service. You'll:
Speak with customers to understand their needs and help them explore suitable insurance options.
Build lasting relationships by delivering excellent customer service and support.
Provide guidance on a range of personal insurance products.
Prepare and manage quotations, renewals and policy changes.
Work closely with insurers and underwriters to find the best solutions for customers.
Support customers across phone, email and other communication channels.
Maintain accurate customer records and ensure regulatory requirements are met.
Continue developing your knowledge and professional skills through ongoing training and development opportunities.
About You
Enjoy helping customers and providing excellent service.
Are confident communicators and enjoy building relationships.
Bring a positive attitude and a willingness to learn.
Are organised and able to manage multiple priorities.
Enjoy solving problems and finding practical solutions.
Work well as part of a team and support those around them.
Are comfortable using technology and learning new systems.
Take pride in doing a great job and delivering high standards.
Most importantly, you do not need insurance experience.
If you have strong customer service skills and a willingness to learn, we'd love to hear from you.
Essential Requirements
Leaving Certificate (or equivalent qualification), or a relevant third-level qualification.
The willingness and commitment to work towards the professional insurance qualifications required within the industry.
Eligibility to work in Ireland.
Insurance might not be something you've considered before, but it offers a rewarding and long-term career with plenty of opportunities to grow. At GMIB, part of Gallagher, you'll join a team that's supportive, welcoming and invested in your success from day one. We'll help you gain valuable skills, build your confidence and develop a career that can take you in many different directions.
Compensation And Benefits
At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.
Competitive compensation
Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact
At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.

This is a research focused role with a high level of external engagement aimed at shaping the future of airspace operations from concept definition through to demonstration. Lead a team of ATM & UTM technologists addressing emerging concepts such as Trajectory-based Operations (TBO), high-altitude and very low-altitude airspace operations, across the ATM, HAPS, UTM, and space-based domains. Lead focused R&D projects in the context of the European SESAR research framework for future ATM technologies, including acting as overall project coordinator alongside consortium partners, being the key point of contact for the SESAR customer and internal Collins stakeholders, and overall project representative at industry dissemination events.

jobs.title: Global Automation Lead
jobs.desc:
Overview
The Automation Lead is responsible for leading a global engineering group and setting the automation agenda for PGCS across two critical business areas: the Capital agenda and the Sustain agenda. This role provides strategic leadership for automation design, execution, operational technology, cybersecurity, standards, and site technical support across all PGCS sites.
The role acts as the global automation authority for strategic capital projects, site issue resolution, operational technology sustainment, and future automation capability. The Automation Lead ensures that automation standards, best practices, and cybersecurity requirements are consistently applied across strategic and base projects, while enabling reliable, secure, and future-ready manufacturing operations.
Responsibilities
Global Automation Leadership
Lead a global engineering automation group supporting PGCS manufacturing operations and capital delivery.
Define, own, and execute the global automation agenda across Capital and Sustain priorities.
Provide leadership, governance, and technical direction to ensure automation solutions are robust, scalable, secure, and aligned with business needs.
Act as the senior automation point of contact for global stakeholders, site teams, engineering, IT/OT, and external partners.
Capital Agenda: Global Design and Execution
Lead the strategic automation group responsible for the design and execution of all strategic capital projects.
Ensure automation standards, best practices, and governance requirements are followed across strategic and base capital projects for all sites.
Provide technical leadership for automation scope definition, architecture, vendor selection, design reviews, commissioning, validation, and operational handover.
Partner with capital project teams to ensure automation solutions are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the required technical standard.
Serve as the SME lead for new technologies and future capital initiatives, ensuring emerging automation capability is evaluated and deployed where it creates business value.
Sustain Agenda: Operational Technology and Site Support
Lead the global Operational Technology agenda for PGCS automation, supporting sustain processes, IT/OT initiatives, and technology projects.
Manage the automation technology sustain program, ensuring platforms, infrastructure, software, and standards remain current, reliable, and secure.
Provide global site technical support and issue resolution, acting as the escalation point for automation-related challenges across all sites.
Lead problem solving, root cause analysis, and corrective actions for complex automation and OT issues escalated by sites.
Provide SME leadership in System Platform, Digital Factory, software migration, cybersecurity, change management, and related automation technologies.
Automation Standards and Governance
Own and maintain the PGCS automation standards portfolio, including 25 automation standards that define best practice across automation initiatives and projects.
Ensure standards are consistently applied across capital projects, sustain activities, site initiatives, vendor deliverables, and technology deployments.
Drive continuous improvement of standards based on lessons learned, technology evolution, cybersecurity requirements, and operational feedback.
Provide governance and assurance to ensure automation designs are consistent, supportable, secure, and aligned to PGCS and PepsiCo requirements.
Cybersecurity and IT/OT Compliance
Ensure PGCS compliance with cybersecurity sustain standards including NIST, ISA/IEC 62443, and PepsiCo Global Controls across all sites.
Lead the mitigation of cybersecurity risks across operational technology environments, working with sites, IT, engineering, and external partners.
Ensure all sites are progressing completion and build-out of DAS networks in line with cybersecurity and operational requirements.
Support cybersecurity assessments, remediation plans, system hardening, change management, backup and recovery, and audit readiness across the automation landscape.
Qualifications
Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Engineering, or related engineering discipline; master’s degree preferred.
Significant experience in automation, controls, operational technology, or digital manufacturing within a complex manufacturing environment.
Proven experience leading global or multi-site automation teams, programs, standards, and governance models.
Strong track record in capital project automation design, execution, commissioning, and operational handover.
Demonstrated knowledge of OT cybersecurity, IT/OT integration, industrial networks, and automation system lifecycle management.
Technical Expertise
Automation architecture, PLC, HMI, SCADA, System Platform, historian, and industrial network technologies.
Digital Factory, smart manufacturing, data connectivity, and future automation technologies.
OT cybersecurity frameworks including NIST, ISA/IEC 62443, and corporate global controls.
Software migration, platform lifecycle management, technology sustainment, and change control.
Capital project delivery, vendor management, commissioning, validation, and operational readiness
Leadership Competencies
Strategic leadership and ability to set a compelling automation vision.
Strong stakeholder management across global engineering, operations, IT, cybersecurity, and site leadership teams.
Ability to influence standards adoption and drive governance across multiple sites and projects.
Excellent problem-solving capability with the ability to lead complex technical issue resolution.
Strong coaching, communication, and capability-building skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

Renewable Energy Analyst (Graduate)
Location:
Cork (hybrid)
Salary:
€45,000 - €55,000, depending on experience
Type:
Full-time, permanent
About us
We are a clean energy company that develops, builds, owns and operates renewable projects across the island of Ireland, with a portfolio spanning onshore wind, solar and battery energy storage (BESS). From our Cork office, our team supports projects across Munster and the wider island, in one of Europe's most exciting renewable energy markets. We are looking for a graduate analyst to help power that growth.
What you will do
You will work at the analytical heart of the business, supporting decisions across development, finance and operations. Expect variety, real responsibility and plenty of learning. Your work will include:
Building and maintaining models for project economics, energy production and market analysis
Conducting research on markets, policy, technologies and competitors to support strategic decisions
Supporting due diligence on new projects and acquisitions, working with data from every corner of the business
Analysing performance data from our operating fleet and reporting on trends and improvements
Preparing clear reports, dashboards and presentations for project teams and senior leadership
Supporting the development team with data for grid applications, planning and site selection
Improving the spreadsheets, tools and datasets the whole company relies on
What we are looking for
A degree (2.1 or above) in finance, economics, engineering, environmental science, data analytics or a related field
A genuine interest in renewable energy and the clean energy transition
Strong analytical skills and real comfort in Excel; experience with Python, SQL or data visualisation tools is an advantage
Attention to detail and the discipline to get the numbers right
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn analysis into insight
Initiative and curiosity: you take ownership, ask good questions and learn quickly
The right to work in Ireland
Internship or project experience in energy, finance or data analysis is an advantage but not essential. We hire for aptitude and attitude, and we invest in developing our people.
What we offer
€45,000 - €55,000 starting salary, depending on experience
Hybrid working from our Cork office
A structured development path with mentorship from experienced analysts and managers
Exposure to development, finance and operations across three technologies
Pension contributions, generous annual leave and wellbeing support
Support for professional development and further study
The chance to grow with a company building and operating real clean energy assets
How to apply
Apply with your CV and a short note on why this role interests you. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
We are an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are available on request at any stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.desc:
Join a globally recognised technology business developing advanced silicon and software solutions for high-performance and embedded computing. As part of a specialist compiler engineering team, you’ll help develop and evolve the software toolchain that enables customers to maximise the performance of custom processor architectures.
You’ll work alongside compiler engineers, CPU architects, and systems specialists on backend compiler development, performance optimisation, and production-grade tooling used across compute-intensive applications.

Design, implement, and maintain compiler functionality using modern C++
Develop backend compiler features, including code generation and target-specific optimisations
Improve generated code quality, runtime performance, and compilation efficiency
Work closely with architecture and hardware engineering teams to support new processor capabilities
Investigate compiler defects, performance regressions, and low-level software issues
Compiler Software Engineer Experience
Understanding of compiler design, optimisation techniques, intermediate representations, or computer architecture
Commercial or research experience in compiler engineering, systems software, or low-level programming
Strong C/C++ development skills
Desirable Experience
LLVM, GCC, MLIR, or other compiler frameworks

Embedded software or processor architecture
Assembly language, debugging, or performance tuning

jobs.title: VAT Accountant
jobs.desc:
We are delighted to be working with a large, well-established multinational manufacturer who are growing their Indirect Tax team here in Cork. This group is present in over 50 countries and their products end up behind some of the best-known consumer and industrial brands in the world.
Their Cork shared service centre plays a genuinely central role in the group's global finance operations, and it's an exciting time to join as they push further into digitalisation and modernise how the function works.
About the role
The VAT Accountant will join a small, close-knit and experienced team. It's a broad, business-facing role with VAT and indirect tax at its core, alongside ledger management, balance sheet and system reconciliations, period-end close, and ERP troubleshooting. It's a great fit for someone who wants their VAT expertise to plug into the wider business.
Responsibilities
Support the VAT and indirect tax compliance process across multiple jurisdictions
Contribute to month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close, including reconciliations and reporting
Help resolve day-to-day system and process issues, working closely with IT and other teams
Build strong working relationships with auditors and tax authorities as a key point of contact
Get involved in improving processes and controls as the function continues to evolve
About you
Qualified accountant or tax consultant
Ideally some multinational experience or hands on experience from an accounting firm
Comfortable with ERP systems (Oracle Financials or similar); strong Excel skills is an advantage
A "solutionist" mindset - curious, keen to connect the dots rather than just process transactions
Initiative and enthusiasm, with genuine interest in getting closer to the wider business
If this sounds like a fit, I'd love to hear from you - contact me, aideen.murphy@barden.ie.

jobs.title: Receptionist/Office Administrator
jobs.desc:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.
At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.
AI Fearlessly.
Receptionist & Office Administrator
The Role
The Receptionist & Office Administrator will provide a high standard of front-of-house and administrative support within the European Operation Centre, in Cork. The role is responsible for creating a welcoming and professional experience for employees, visitors and customers, while supporting the smooth day-to-day operation of the office.
The role will have a particular focus on reception and visitor management, internal events, hotel and travel bookings, meeting room coordination, purchasing and the effective management of office access control systems.
The successful candidate will be highly organised, customer-focused and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and respond confidently to the changing needs of a busy office environment.
Key Duties & Responsibilities
Provide a professional and welcoming reception service, including meeting and greeting employees, visitors and customers.
Deliver a consistently high level of customer service to both internal and external stakeholders.
Manage visitor access and support the effective operation of the office access control system.
Coordinate hotel accommodation and related arrangements for visitors and employees attending the European Operation Centre in Cork.
Support the planning and coordination of internal meetings, events and employee activities, including meeting room set-up and logistics.
Coordinate meeting room bookings and ensure rooms are appropriately prepared for meetings and events.
Assist with purchasing activities, including raising orders and liaising with suppliers as required.
Provide general administrative support to the office and wider administration team.
Develop and maintain effective administrative processes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Liaise with internal teams, external suppliers and service providers to ensure a high-quality office experience.
Respond proactively to queries and issues, taking ownership through to resolution where appropriate.
Qualifications / Professional Certifications
A relevant qualification in Business Administration, Office Administration, Hospitality or a related discipline is desirable.
Equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
Experience & Skills Required
Minimum of 3 years’ experience in reception, office administration, hospitality or a similar customer-facing role.
Strong customer service and interpersonal skills, with a professional and approachable manner.
Experience working effectively within a busy, multicultural environment is desirable.
Excellent organisational and administrative skills, with strong attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure and meet deadlines. Proactive approach, with the initiative and confidence to identify and resolve issues independently.
Strong team player who works collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders. Good problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and general office systems. Fluency in English, both written and verbal, is essential.
The Successful Candidate Will Be
Customer-focused – committed to providing a welcoming and professional experience.
Qrganised – able to manage competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
Proactive – takes ownership and looks for ways to improve how things are done.
Flexible – comfortable adapting to changing requirements and priorities.
Professional – represents the organisation positively when dealing with employees, customers and visitors.
Collaborative – works effectively as part of a team and across different functions.
At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. Our diversity and multicultural workforce are key contributing factors to our success across the globe. We like to have fun while taking our culture seriously. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.desc:
About Advanced Energy
Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: AEIS) empowers innovation across the world’s most advanced semiconductor and industrial applications. We design and manufacture precision power and control solutions that enable breakthrough technologies in thin film deposition, industrial manufacturing, and medical power systems. With a proud heritage, award winning technology, and a global workforce, Advanced Energy is committed to fostering innovation, collaboration, and career growth.
Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced and innovative Mechanical Engineer to join our Future Technologies team at our Cork facility. In this role, you will lead the mechanical design and development of new, next generation power platforms from concept through production. You will collaborate closely with cross functional engineering, manufacturing, and supplier teams to deliver high quality, manufacturable solutions that meet both customer and regulatory requirements.
This position offers the opportunity to work on new to the world designs, influence technology architecture, and provide technical leadership within a highly skilled engineering team.
Essential Responsibilities
Lead mechanical design for new technology platforms, including concept development, detailed design, and release to manufacturing
Develop complex mechanical solutions across sheet metal, plastics, and machined components
Diagnose and resolve complex design and manufacturability issues, implementing effective corrective actions
Support the development and integration of new technologies into manufacturing processes
Collaborate with manufacturing partners to ensure designs are cost effective, robust, and manufacturable at scale
Ensure design documentation complies with Advanced Energy standards and applicable regulatory requirements
Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and support to less experienced engineers and designers
Participate in design reviews, technical meetings, and cross functional problem solving activities
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies and share insights across the team
Maintain organized filing of design and parts data
Work within project schedule and budgets
Experience
5–7 years of mechanical technology design experience, with additional experience in drafting or equivalent practical expertise
Strong background in CNC machining, soft and hard tooling, and design for mass production
Hands on experience with manufacturing processes and design for manufacturability (DFM)
Proven expertise in the design, documentation, and maintenance of sheet metal, plastic, and mechanical assemblies
Education
Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline
Technical & Professional Skills
Strong working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) and ISO GPS standards
Advanced proficiency with CAD, Thermal Analysis, FEA tools. Solidworks etc.
Ability to manage projects from concept through release, including schedules and resource coordination
Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to exercise sound engineering judgment
Comfortable defining methods and procedures for new or complex design challenges
Demonstrated leadership, communication, and mentoring capabilities
Why Join Advanced Energy?
Work on cutting edge medical power technologies with real world impact
Collaborate with highly skilled global engineering teams
Influence technology platforms from early concept through full production
Be part of a company that values innovation, technical excellence, and employee development

A variety of shifts

nd

Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move.  Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”.  Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers.  It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Outreach provides an individualised, rights based programme tailored to each participant. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting an individual to attend chosen activities in their local community and work towards achieving their identified goals.
Outreach places a strong emphasis on enhancing the quality of life for those we support and operates in line with the HSE New Directions model of care. This position is ideal for someone who is comfortable working alone, self motivated, independent, and confident in their ability to make decisions and solve problems. Experience supporting adults with autism is an advantage.
The Role:
The Support Worker will play a vital role in empowering individuals by planning and setting meaningful goals that address their unique personal, social, recreational, academic, independent living, community integration, training, and supported employment needs.
They will actively guide and support individuals to realise their aspirations, helping them reach identified priorities and achieve greater independence and self sufficiency. They will also advocate for inclusion and active participation in the community, ensuring access to opportunities that promote social and personal growth.
The Support Worker operates within a person centred framework, prioritising each individual’s choices and needs. They will work closely with both internal and external services, fostering a culture of collaboration and partnership, and building strong relationships with families to ensure holistic support.
In addition to supporting adults with intellectual disabilities, the Support Worker will be responsible for maintaining accurate records, completing relevant reports, and ensuring all documentation meets required standards. The role includes providing physical, emotional, psychological, and healthcare support, all while promoting dignity, respect, and personal autonomy.
They will also facilitate life skills development through hobbies, interests, and activities, teaching skills such as budgeting, cooking, communication, and time management to promote greater independence.
The Support Worker will work alongside a range of healthcare professionals to ensure all aspects of care are delivered to the highest standard. Their input will be essential in creating care plans that are responsive to evolving needs, fostering personal growth, wellbeing, and a sense of belonging within the community.
This is a dynamic and rewarding position that requires dedication, a commitment to lifelong learning, and a strong passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of those supported.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills to engage effectively with individuals, families, colleagues, managers, and senior team members.

Highly Desirable Criteria:

Experience of liaising with statutory and other voluntary agencies.
